Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

* Deliver Results

* Ability to create service responses in multiple formats including JSON, XML

* Ensure continued accountability for product and services delivery within assigned business units and across IT
* Ensure quality and performance standards are met across omnichannel customer experiences including kiosks, mobile, and web platforms
* Partner with other IT Managers to ensure alignment and drive efficiencies
* Provide direct or indirect oversight of delivery teams for applicable portfolio initiatives
* Take a significant role in leading and coaching direct team and/or indirect crewmembers to support the engagement, growth and development of succession plan for the IT department
* Other duties as assigned

* Three (3\) years in a full\-stack role, with experience in coding both JavaScript\-based applications and backend applications, as well as optimizing the communication middleware protocol
* Experience with RESTful services, JSON, and SOAP\-based services
* Experience using Git
* Demonstrated ability to code complex full\-stack designs in a modular, well architected manner; experience with responsive/adaptive design, and efficient middleware communication
* Candidates must demonstrate coding skills in a work sample assessment
* Available for moderate overnight travel (up to 35%)
* In possession of valid travel documents with the ability to travel in and out of the United States
* Able to work flexible hours and be available for emergency response on short notice
* Must pass a pre\-employment drug test
* Must be legally eligible to work in the country in which the position is located
* Authorization to work in the US is required. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications*** One (1\) year in React and some experience with AngularJS. Thorough knowledge of business function and thorough knowledge of business operations, objectives and strategies
* Previous knowledge with micro service development
* Benchmarking experience of services as a whole, from the front to the back\-end technology
* Knowledge of omnichannel customer experiences across kiosks, mobile, and web platforms
* Exposure to JetBlue’s IT disciplines and interdependencies
* Exposure to JetBlue’s business units and how their needs drive IT strategy
* Working on enterprise\-wide budget process

**Crewmember Expectations:*** Regular attendance and punctuality
* Potential need to work flexible hours and be available to respond on short\-notice
* Able to maintain a professional appearance
* When working or traveling on JetBlue flights, and if time permits, all capable crewmembers are asked to assist with light cleaning of the aircraft
* Must be an appropriate organizational fit for the JetBlue culture, that is, exhibit the JetBlue values of Safety, Caring, Integrity, Passion and Fun
* Promote JetBlue’s \#1 value of safety as a Safety Ambassador, supporting JetBlue’s Safety Management System (SMS) components, Safety Policy and behavioral standards
* Identify safety and/or security concerns, issues, incidents or hazards that should be reported and report them whenever possible and by any means necessary including JetBlue’s confidential reporting systems (Aviation Safety Action Program (ASAP) or Safety Action Report (SAR))
* The use of ChatGPT or any other automated tool during the interview process will disqualify a candidate from being considered for the position

**Equipment:**
* Computer and other office equipment

**Work Environment:**
* Traditional office environment

**Physical Effort:*** Generally not required, or up to 10 pounds occasionally, 0 pounds frequently (Sedentary)

description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.


**Job overview:**



We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to lead development of critical platform capabilities that power Omada's connected care experience. This role focuses on building and scaling reliable systems that integrate and validate critical health data and enable real‑time, clinically meaningful insights for care teams and members.



You will operate at the intersection of data integrations, backend systems, and healthcare workflows, delivering accurate, timely, and actionable data that directly impacts patient outcomes.


**Your Impact:**



As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of backend services and platform capabilities that support large‑scale, data‑rich applications. You will own projects end‑to‑end from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing reliability while partnering with product, data science, and clinical teams to turn complex requirements into simple, robust solutions.


* Design and build scalable backend systems that ingest, process, and serve high‑volume health data.
* Lead technical initiatives that improve data reliability, observability, and end‑to‑end system performance.
* Drive architecture decisions for integrations with third‑party data sources and APIs.
* Partner closely with product, clinical, and data teams to translate healthcare needs into robust technical solutions.
* Improve system resilience and data quality, ensuring correctness in clinically relevant workflows.
* Mentor engineers and elevate engineering standards through design reviews, testing practices, and operational excellence.
* Contribute to roadmap planning, breaking down ambiguous problems into clear, actionable engineering work.


**About you:**


* You are comfortable taking ownership of complex systems and leading projects from concept through production.
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus using modern frameworks (Ruby on Rails, Python).
* Experience with a relational database (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* Experience designing and operating distributed systems with high reliability and data integrity requirements.
* Experience working with data pipelines, event‑driven architectures, or real‑time processing systems.
* You care deeply about reliability, testing, and documentation, and treat them as core parts of engineering, not afterthoughts.
* You communicate clearly with technical and non‑technical partners and can translate business and clinical needs into technical plans.
* Comfortable working cross‑functionally and navigating ambiguity in a fast‑paced environment.


**Bonus Points for:**


* Experience with healthcare systems, medical devices, or regulated environments (HIPAA, FDA, etc.).
* Familiarity with device integrations such as CGMs, wearables, or remote monitoring tools.
* Experience improving data quality, validation systems, or reconciliation pipelines.
* Background in building platforms or infrastructure systems used by multiple teams.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and modern CI/CD practices.


**Technologies we use:**



AWS, Ruby, Rails, Postgres, GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes


**Benefits:**


* Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
* Equity grants
* Remote first work from home culture
* Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
* Generous parental leave
* Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
* 401k retirement savings plan
* Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
* Mental Health Support Solutions
* ...and more!


It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day\-to\-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!


* **Cultivate Trust.** We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
* **Seek Context.** We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
* **Act Boldly.** We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
* **Deliver Results.** We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we're not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
* **Succeed Together.** We prioritize Omada's progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
* **Remember Why We're Here.** We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.


**About Omada Health:** Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada's virtual\-first model combines human\-led care teams, connected devices, and AI\-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP\-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000\+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.



Omada is thrilled to share that we've been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.



We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.



Below is a summary of salary ranges for this role in the following geographies:



California, New York State and Washington State Base Compensation Ranges: $179,400 \- $224,300\*, Colorado Base Compensation Ranges: $171,600 \- $214,500\*. Other states may vary.



This role is also eligible for participation in annual cash bonus and equity grants.


* The actual offer, including the compensation package, is determined based on multiple factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience, and other business considerations.



Please click here for more information on our Candidate Privacy Notice.

GitHub Planning and Tracking is a market\-leading service to manage and track work alongside the code where it happens.

In this role you will be a leader and multiplier within our distributed team who will not only design, prototype, implement, ship and support highly performant and inspiring user experiences, but will also help us uncover and solve tricky and foundational scaling and user\-experience problems that will unlock further Copilot integration into existing and future GitHub Issues and Projects. **Responsibilities**

**API Engineering \& Application Development**

* Implement clean, testable, and well‑documented Python code suitable for enterprise production environments.
* Optimize API performance, reliability, scalability, and error handling.
* Ensure proper API versioning, contract stability, and backward compatibility.

**Security \& Access Management**

**Automation \& Infrastructure Engineering**

* Provision and manage AWS infrastructure using **Terraform**.

	+ API Gateway
	+ Lambda
	+ IAM roles and policies
	+ CloudWatch logging and monitoring
* Ensure environment consistency across **DEV, QA, UAT, and PROD**.

**CI/CD \& Operational Excellence**

* Design and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for build, test, and deployment of Python APIs.
* Support automated testing, packaging, versioning, and release management.
* Implement observability through **logging, metrics, alerts, and tracing**.
* Participate in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and production support activities.

**Cross‑Team Collaboration**

* Align API design and implementation with enterprise architectural standards.
* Actively contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and technical documentation.
* Promote best practices and a culture of engineering excellence.

**Strategic Influence**

* Influence API engineering standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization.
* Contribute to architectural reviews and modernization efforts.
* Help drive consistent, scalable, and maintainable cloud‑native API solutions.

We are looking for strong collaborators who deliver reliable, secure, and high‑quality API solutions in fast‑paced, team‑oriented environments. **We Are Route**



When shoppers hit "buy," a great customer experience doesn't end, it's just getting started. For too long, everything after checkout has been the weakest link in ecommerce: confusing tracking, lost or damaged packages, clunky returns, and missed opportunities to turn first\-time buyers into lifelong fans. That's why we built Route.



Our mission is simple: **we create shopper confidence that fuels brand growth.** Route is the leading post\-purchase platform for modern ecommerce, trusted by over 13,000 brands and protecting more than $20 billion in gross merchandise value to date. From package protection and industry\-leading order tracking to returns and exchanges, cash back loyalty, and engaging product recommendations, Route brings every moment after checkout into one powerful platform, empowering shoppers with visibility and peace of mind while giving merchants loyalty that lasts well beyond the first sale.



Since launching in 2018, Route has raised over $250 million from leading investors including Craft Ventures, Hedosophia, and Hanaco Ventures, and has grown into a complete post\-purchase ecosystem loved by millions of shoppers and the brands they buy from. Throughout that growth, we've stayed committed to building innovative products that empower our customers and to fostering a people\-first, values\-driven culture that makes Route a place where great work and great people thrive.



We're looking for talented people across the ecommerce space to join us on the next chapter of this adventure. Don't just take our word for it, Discover what life at Route has to offer.


**The team**



The Core Backend Engineering team builds the foundational systems that power Route's post\-purchase experience and help connect the world's commerce through innovative, scalable products. Our team owns the highly available, business\-critical services behind Package Protection, Returns Protection, claims, order management, shipment tracking, merchant integrations, and more.



Core Engineers solve complex distributed systems challenges at scale, building reliable platforms, APIs, and services that process millions of events and support merchants, partners, consumers, and internal teams every day.



As a member of the Core team, you'll help shape the architecture behind Route's continued growth while collaborating with a talented engineering organization passionate about creating seamless commerce experiences for millions of consumers around the world.


**The opportunity**



The Core Backend team at Route is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help design, build, and scale the services that power our end\-to\-end post\-purchase experience.



In this role, you'll solve complex backend challenges across our Orders platform, Tracking services, merchant APIs, third\-party integrations, and other foundational systems that support millions of shipments. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering teams, and external partners to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that create seamless experiences for merchants and consumers.



We're looking for someone who thrives in complex distributed systems, takes ownership from design through production, and is passionate about building technology that has meaningful business impact. You'll influence technical decisions, mentor other engineers, establish best practices, and help shape the future of Route's core platform.


**What you'll do**


* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain highly scalable backend services using Go.
* Own critical services supporting Package Protection, Returns Protection, Claims, Orders, Tracking, and Email Parsing.
* Design and evolve distributed systems and event\-driven architectures that process high volumes of transactions reliably.
* Build and maintain REST and GraphQL APIs used by internal products, merchants, and external partners.
* Develop and improve integrations with merchant platforms, carriers, and third\-party APIs.
* Optimize system performance, reliability, scalability, and observability across production services.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in architectural decisions and continuously improve engineering standards and operational excellence.


**What we're looking for**


* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and scaling backend systems.
* Experience designing, deploying, and supporting distributed systems in production environments.
* Proficiency with Go, or experience with another modern backend language and excitement to build expertise in Go.
* Experience building and maintaining cloud\-based services, preferably within AWS environments.
* Experience working with relational databases, distributed databases, and NoSQL technologies (such as CockroachDB, DynamoDB, or similar platforms).
* Experience designing and building scalable APIs, including REST, GraphQL, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of event\-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging patterns, and high\-volume data processing.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform or similar technologies.
* Experience with monitoring, observability, and improving platform reliability using tools such as Grafana or similar platforms.
* Strong foundation in software engineering principles, system design, and scalable architecture patterns.
* Ability to communicate effectively, collaborate across teams, and mentor engineers through technical guidance and best practices.
* Experience partnering with third\-party APIs, external integrations, or complex technical ecosystems.
* Interest in improving engineering practices, operational excellence, and developer productivity.
* Experience in ecommerce, logistics, shipping, post\-purchase platforms, or similar domains is helpful but not required.
* BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.


**Equal opportunity for all**



Route is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.


**Total Rewards**



We know our team works best when everyone feels happy, healthy, and supported. We offer to pay 95% \- 100% of your health insurance premiums for you and your family, remote or hybrid work arrangements, unlimited PTO, 401k matching, formalized growth opportunities, learning \& development, DEI programs \& events, and so much more.


**Pay Transparency**


**Salary for this role:**


**National:** $171,000 \- $181,000


**Brazil:** $87,000 \- $92,000


*The cash compensation above includes base salary, and is not reflective of potential commission for employees in eligible roles, or annual bonus targets under Route's bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, all Route employees are eligible to participate in Routes equity incentive plan to receive stock options per the terms of the agreement. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are based on a few different factors unique to each candidate, including their career level, skills, experience, specific geographic location qualifications and other job\-related reasons.*

* Authentication \& Authorization

* Strong experience developing applications using C\# and ASP.NET Core.
* Experience building RESTful APIs.

* Experience working with Azure cloud services.
* Experience with Git and Azure DevOps.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience troubleshooting production issues and supporting enterprise applications.

United States
  
**Technical Fellow**


Software Platforms


**General Overview**


AI is collapsing the cost of building software, and Ralliant intends to lead, not follow. We're building a shared platform that reinvents how our operating companies create and ship software, starting with an AI\-first approach to developer productivity. From there, the platform grows into shared services that let operating companies bring new software offerings to market and commercialize them more quickly. Operating companies own their products, customers, and roadmaps, while the platform provides the common foundation they build on rather than rebuild.


The title centers on platform engineering, but the work spans four competencies: **cloud engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, and software engineering**. Strong candidates are deep in at least one and capable across all four, and they stay hands\-on in the code while helping steward the architecture and standards the platform depends on.


The Technical Fellow is the most senior individual contributor in the Software Platforms organization and a principal technical authority for the platform. The Fellow builds core capability hands\-on, stewards the reference architecture and the standards operating companies adopt, and mentors the engineers doing the work. The role reports to the Chief Software Platform Officer and partners closely with the Director of Technical Product Management and technical leadership across the operating companies.


**Responsibilities**


* Build platform capability hands\-on: design and ship core platform services end to end, from architecture through production and ongoing operation, as self\-service capabilities that operating\-company engineers adopt with minimal friction.
* Steward the platform's architecture and standards, shaping the reference architecture, golden paths, and paved roads, and turning engineering standards into executable guidance through the Architecture Council.
* Advance AI\-first software delivery by building and evolving the templates, pipelines, and golden paths that raise developer throughput, and help extend the platform into shared services that support new software offerings.
* Own reliability, security, and cost for the services you build: define SLIs and SLOs, instrument observability, run incident response, and reduce toil through automation, with security and cost designed in from the start.
* Set the technical bar and mentor: raise the level of platform and operating\-company engineers through hands\-on engineering, code review, and mentorship, and help build a connected engineering community across the portfolio.

**Qualifications**


* **Depth.** 20\+ years across the platform disciplines (platform engineering, cloud, DevOps, SRE, and software engineering), with a substantial track record building and operating platform or infrastructure services at scale, and recognized as a technical authority who sets direction across teams.
* **Platform engineering.** Hands\-on experience building internal developer platforms and shared services used by many teams or business units (self\-service, golden paths, API versioning and backward compatibility, adoption), with a platform\-as\-product mindset that treats engineers as customers and reduces their cognitive load.
* **Cloud engineering.** Strong, current, hands\-on expertise on AWS (or Azure/GCP): containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar), and practical command of networking, identity, security posture, and cost.
* **DevOps.** Deep hands\-on CI/CD and GitOps experience, building and operating delivery pipelines and environment automation, and improving the developer experience of shipping change safely and fast.
* **Site reliability engineering.** Production\-ownership experience: SLIs and SLOs, error budgets, observability, incident response, capacity planning, and toil reduction through automation.
* **Software engineering.** An excellent engineer with strong design sensibility (API contracts, clean abstractions, separation of concerns) who builds production services as durable products and stays hands\-on in the code. Fluent in at least one modern backend language (Go, Python, TypeScript, or similar), with sound build\-vs\-buy judgment.
* **Platform security.** Hands\-on cloud\-native security expertise (IAM, OAuth/OIDC, secrets and workload identity, certificate lifecycle, policy\-as\-code, and secure software supply chain), with a track record of building secure\-by\-default platforms.
* **Architecture and standards stewardship.** A track record of shaping reference architectures, golden paths, and engineering standards that other teams adopt, turning them into executable guidance rather than documentation.
* **AI\-first delivery.** Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development and agentic coding workflows (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar), able to define best practices and guardrails and to shape how these tools change delivery, code quality, and team structure.
* **Influence and communication.** Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to build trust across organizational boundaries, align engineers across operating companies, and mentor without relying on positional authority.

\#LI\-RG1


**Ralliant Corporation Overview**


Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next\-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high\-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission\-critical advancements across industries, enabling real\-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we’re building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**You Have:**

* 8\+ years of experience in software development including backend and services, including in a lead or senior role on delivered systems
* Experience in a server\-side language, such as Java, .NET, C\#, Python, or Go, including building microservices and well\-designed RESTful APIs
* Experience with relational and NoSQL data stores, including schema and data modeling
* Experience with message or streaming platforms, such as Kafka, and containerization
* Experience with frontend, such as React, to contribute across the full stack
* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployment
* Ability to translate mission and reliability requirements into scalable, resilient service designs
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a technology field, or 6\+ years of experience in mission systems in lieu of a degree

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with event\-driven architecture and distributed system patterns, such as CQRS, event sourcing, and sagas
* Experience with cloud\-native development on AWS or Kubernetes
* Experience implementing a secure SDLC, including scanning, secrets management, and secure coding practices
* Experience with C2, ISR, or other mission\-critical DoD systems and their operational constraints
* Experience with API gateways, service mesh, and inter\-service security such as mTLS or OAuth2/OIDC
* Experience with observability for distributed services, such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry
* Secret clearance
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II Security\+ CE or equivalent certification

**Clearance:**


Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

**Compensation**


At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. **Company Introduction:**



Airspace is a tech\-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.



As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission\-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.


Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers, listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies, and featured as an Innovation and Disruption leader by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.



The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time\-critical logistics.

**Engineer the Workflows Behind Mission\-Critical Deliveries**
--------------------------------------------------------------



Airspace delivers service levels that no team could achieve on manual effort alone. Our platform is what makes that possible — a mature, deeply capable system that encodes exactly how, when, and under what conditions every order activity should happen. The more faithfully that technology reflects the real\-world needs of each customer, the more our people are freed to do what they do best: execute flawlessly when failure is not an option.

  



We're looking for a **Solutions Engineer** to join our R\&D team and own that translation layer between the customer and the platform. You'll take complex, real\-world customer Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and turn them into precise, custom workflows inside our core system — software defined workflows that govern the rules and timing of every order activity. You'll also configure the mobile workflows our drivers follow in the field, ensuring that every customer\-specified action is performed correctly, every time.

  


**This is a role for someone who finds deep satisfaction in taking something ambiguous and complicated and making it exact.**

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Partner Across Customers and Internal Teams**



Work closely with onboarding, operations, account management, and product to gather requirements, clarify ambiguity in customer SOPs, and validate that configured workflows reflect real operational intent. Serve as the bridge between what a customer says they need and how the platform delivers it.


### **Translate Customer SOPs into Intelligent Workflows**



Take detailed, often complex customer SOPs and parse them into highly accurate, custom workflows within Airspace's core platform. Build and maintain the JSON\-defined workflow diagrams that specify all the business rules for a customer — including which order activities occur, when they're triggered, and under what conditions. Own the accuracy and completeness of these configurations end to end.


### **Configure Field \& Mobile Driver Workflows**



Configure the mobile workflows that guide drivers through customer\-specific activities in the field. Ensure that every required step — captures, scans, confirmations, exception handling — is presented correctly and in the right sequence, so that what happens on the ground matches exactly what the customer expects.


### **Maintain, Test, and Evolve Configurations**



Rigorously test and validate workflows before they go live, and iterate as customer requirements change over time. Catch edge cases before they become field problems, and continuously improve the reliability of the configurations you own.


### **Build for Scale and Reuse**



Identify common patterns across customers and verticals, and design reusable workflow components and templates that reduce configuration time and increase consistency. Help shape the tooling, standards, and best practices that make workflow configuration faster and more reliable as Airspace scales.


### **Measure and Drive Workflow Impact**



Own the metrics that prove your configurations are working as intended. Track how faithfully operations adhere to the workflows you've built — surfacing where reality diverges from the configured procedure and feeding that back into better configurations. Drive up the share of orders that run on auto\-pilot, where the platform executes the right activities at the right time without manual intervention. And monitor service levels across orders governed by Task Workflows, ensuring that the precision of your configurations translates directly into reliable, on\-time, mission\-critical delivery. Use these signals — adherence, automation rate, and service\-level performance — to continuously identify what to refine next.

  


**Requirements**
----------------


* 2–4\+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation, systems configuration, business analysis, or a comparable role that bridges customer requirements and a technical platform.
* **A proven background taking complicated SOPs and parsing them into actionable process flow diagrams or structured workflows is highly desired.**
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you naturally bring structure to complexity and don't let edge cases slip through.
* Experience governing processes that encourages adoption without proliferation
* Comfort working with structured data and configuration logic (e.g., JSON, rules engines, conditional/branching logic). You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read, reason about, and build logical rule structures confidently.
* Strong communication and requirements\-gathering skills, with the ability to interview stakeholders and customers to surface the real process beneath a written SOP.
* Familiarity with process\-mapping tools (e.g., BPMN, Lucidchart, Visio) is a plus.
* Logistics, supply chain, or operations experience preferred but not required — we'll help you build domain expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  


**Role Details**
----------------


**Department:** R\&D


**Team:** No direct reports initially; you'll collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations, onboarding, and account management. This position will likely grow into an org so manager aspirations are a plus.


**Location:** Carlsbad, CA preferred. Open to remote in the US

  


**Success Metrics**
-------------------


**2026:** Independently own end\-to\-end workflow configuration for new customer onboardings; deliver accurate, on\-time workflow and mobile configurations with minimal field defects. Establish plan to increase company autopilot KPIs and demonstrate ability in one sector.


**2027:** Dramatic increases in autopilot metrics across all sectors.

  


**Your First 90 Days**
----------------------



Build relationships across onboarding, operations, and product; develop deep fluency in Airspace's workflow engine, JSON workflow schema, and mobile configuration tools; shadow customer onboardings; and configure and ship your first customer workflow under guidance.


**Your First 180 Days**
-----------------------



Independently own workflow governance and mobile configuration for new customer onboardings, translate complex SOPs into production\-ready workflows with high accuracy, and begin building reusable components and templates that improve configuration speed and consistency.

  


**Compensation**
----------------


**Salary range:** $88K\-$115K. Base salary is determined by factors such as experience and location.

  


* High\-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
* Open PTO
* 401K with company match

### **Core Values:**


* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.


### **About Airspace:**



From life\-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world's largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time\-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI\-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind\- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time\-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world\-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper\-focused on the needs of our customers and team members.



With offices in the United States in Carlsbad, CA and in Europe in Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Stockholm, and London, we are rapidly scaling into new markets and industries while continuing to innovate and maximize value for our customers. Backed by leading investors including Telstra, HarbourVest, Prologis, Qualcomm, Defy, and others, Airspace has raised $140M to date.



Join our team of 300\+ technologists, futurists, and industry veterans as we work as One Team to revolutionize time\-critical logistics.

  



Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E\-Verify program for all locations.  




*For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.*

**Company Introduction:**



Airspace is a tech\-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.



As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission\-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.


Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers, listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies, and featured as an Innovation and Disruption leader by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.



The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time\-critical logistics.

**Engineer the Workflows Behind Mission\-Critical Deliveries**
--------------------------------------------------------------



Airspace delivers service levels that no team could achieve on manual effort alone. Our platform is what makes that possible — a mature, deeply capable system that encodes exactly how, when, and under what conditions every order activity should happen. The more faithfully that technology reflects the real\-world needs of each customer, the more our people are freed to do what they do best: execute flawlessly when failure is not an option.

  



We're looking for a **Solutions Engineer** to join our R\&D team and own that translation layer between the customer and the platform. You'll take complex, real\-world customer Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and turn them into precise, custom workflows inside our core system — software defined workflows that govern the rules and timing of every order activity. You'll also configure the mobile workflows our drivers follow in the field, ensuring that every customer\-specified action is performed correctly, every time.

  


**This is a role for someone who finds deep satisfaction in taking something ambiguous and complicated and making it exact.**

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Partner Across Customers and Internal Teams**



Work closely with onboarding, operations, account management, and product to gather requirements, clarify ambiguity in customer SOPs, and validate that configured workflows reflect real operational intent. Serve as the bridge between what a customer says they need and how the platform delivers it.


### **Translate Customer SOPs into Intelligent Workflows**



Take detailed, often complex customer SOPs and parse them into highly accurate, custom workflows within Airspace's core platform. Build and maintain the JSON\-defined workflow diagrams that specify all the business rules for a customer — including which order activities occur, when they're triggered, and under what conditions. Own the accuracy and completeness of these configurations end to end.


### **Configure Field \& Mobile Driver Workflows**



Configure the mobile workflows that guide drivers through customer\-specific activities in the field. Ensure that every required step — captures, scans, confirmations, exception handling — is presented correctly and in the right sequence, so that what happens on the ground matches exactly what the customer expects.


### **Maintain, Test, and Evolve Configurations**



Rigorously test and validate workflows before they go live, and iterate as customer requirements change over time. Catch edge cases before they become field problems, and continuously improve the reliability of the configurations you own.


### **Build for Scale and Reuse**



Identify common patterns across customers and verticals, and design reusable workflow components and templates that reduce configuration time and increase consistency. Help shape the tooling, standards, and best practices that make workflow configuration faster and more reliable as Airspace scales.


### **Measure and Drive Workflow Impact**



Own the metrics that prove your configurations are working as intended. Track how faithfully operations adhere to the workflows you've built — surfacing where reality diverges from the configured procedure and feeding that back into better configurations. Drive up the share of orders that run on auto\-pilot, where the platform executes the right activities at the right time without manual intervention. And monitor service levels across orders governed by Task Workflows, ensuring that the precision of your configurations translates directly into reliable, on\-time, mission\-critical delivery. Use these signals — adherence, automation rate, and service\-level performance — to continuously identify what to refine next.

  


**Requirements**
----------------


* 2–4\+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation, systems configuration, business analysis, or a comparable role that bridges customer requirements and a technical platform.
* **A proven background taking complicated SOPs and parsing them into actionable process flow diagrams or structured workflows is highly desired.**
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you naturally bring structure to complexity and don't let edge cases slip through.
* Experience governing processes that encourages adoption without proliferation
* Comfort working with structured data and configuration logic (e.g., JSON, rules engines, conditional/branching logic). You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read, reason about, and build logical rule structures confidently.
* Strong communication and requirements\-gathering skills, with the ability to interview stakeholders and customers to surface the real process beneath a written SOP.
* Familiarity with process\-mapping tools (e.g., BPMN, Lucidchart, Visio) is a plus.
* Logistics, supply chain, or operations experience preferred but not required — we'll help you build domain expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  


**Role Details**
----------------


**Department:** R\&D


**Team:** No direct reports initially; you'll collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations, onboarding, and account management. This position will likely grow into an org so manager aspirations are a plus.


**Location:** Carlsbad, CA preferred. Open to remote in the US

  


**Success Metrics**
-------------------


**2026:** Independently own end\-to\-end workflow configuration for new customer onboardings; deliver accurate, on\-time workflow and mobile configurations with minimal field defects. Establish plan to increase company autopilot KPIs and demonstrate ability in one sector.


**2027:** Dramatic increases in autopilot metrics across all sectors.

  


**Your First 90 Days**
----------------------



Build relationships across onboarding, operations, and product; develop deep fluency in Airspace's workflow engine, JSON workflow schema, and mobile configuration tools; shadow customer onboardings; and configure and ship your first customer workflow under guidance.


**Your First 180 Days**
-----------------------



Independently own workflow governance and mobile configuration for new customer onboardings, translate complex SOPs into production\-ready workflows with high accuracy, and begin building reusable components and templates that improve configuration speed and consistency.

  


**Compensation**
----------------


**Salary range:** $88K\-$115K. Base salary is determined by factors such as experience and location.

  


* High\-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
* Open PTO
* 401K with company match

### **Core Values:**


* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.


### **About Airspace:**



From life\-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world's largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time\-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI\-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind\- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time\-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world\-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper\-focused on the needs of our customers and team members.



With offices in the United States in Carlsbad, CA and in Europe in Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Stockholm, and London, we are rapidly scaling into new markets and industries while continuing to innovate and maximize value for our customers. Backed by leading investors including Telstra, HarbourVest, Prologis, Qualcomm, Defy, and others, Airspace has raised $140M to date.



Join our team of 300\+ technologists, futurists, and industry veterans as we work as One Team to revolutionize time\-critical logistics.

  



Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E\-Verify program for all locations.  




*For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.*

**Company Introduction:**



Airspace is a tech\-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.



As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission\-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.


Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers, listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies, and featured as an Innovation and Disruption leader by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.



The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time\-critical logistics.

**Engineer the Workflows Behind Mission\-Critical Deliveries**
--------------------------------------------------------------



Airspace delivers service levels that no team could achieve on manual effort alone. Our platform is what makes that possible — a mature, deeply capable system that encodes exactly how, when, and under what conditions every order activity should happen. The more faithfully that technology reflects the real\-world needs of each customer, the more our people are freed to do what they do best: execute flawlessly when failure is not an option.

  



We're looking for a **Solutions Engineer** to join our R\&D team and own that translation layer between the customer and the platform. You'll take complex, real\-world customer Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and turn them into precise, custom workflows inside our core system — software defined workflows that govern the rules and timing of every order activity. You'll also configure the mobile workflows our drivers follow in the field, ensuring that every customer\-specified action is performed correctly, every time.

  


**This is a role for someone who finds deep satisfaction in taking something ambiguous and complicated and making it exact.**

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Partner Across Customers and Internal Teams**



Work closely with onboarding, operations, account management, and product to gather requirements, clarify ambiguity in customer SOPs, and validate that configured workflows reflect real operational intent. Serve as the bridge between what a customer says they need and how the platform delivers it.


### **Translate Customer SOPs into Intelligent Workflows**



Take detailed, often complex customer SOPs and parse them into highly accurate, custom workflows within Airspace's core platform. Build and maintain the JSON\-defined workflow diagrams that specify all the business rules for a customer — including which order activities occur, when they're triggered, and under what conditions. Own the accuracy and completeness of these configurations end to end.


### **Configure Field \& Mobile Driver Workflows**



Configure the mobile workflows that guide drivers through customer\-specific activities in the field. Ensure that every required step — captures, scans, confirmations, exception handling — is presented correctly and in the right sequence, so that what happens on the ground matches exactly what the customer expects.


### **Maintain, Test, and Evolve Configurations**



Rigorously test and validate workflows before they go live, and iterate as customer requirements change over time. Catch edge cases before they become field problems, and continuously improve the reliability of the configurations you own.


### **Build for Scale and Reuse**



Identify common patterns across customers and verticals, and design reusable workflow components and templates that reduce configuration time and increase consistency. Help shape the tooling, standards, and best practices that make workflow configuration faster and more reliable as Airspace scales.


### **Measure and Drive Workflow Impact**



Own the metrics that prove your configurations are working as intended. Track how faithfully operations adhere to the workflows you've built — surfacing where reality diverges from the configured procedure and feeding that back into better configurations. Drive up the share of orders that run on auto\-pilot, where the platform executes the right activities at the right time without manual intervention. And monitor service levels across orders governed by Task Workflows, ensuring that the precision of your configurations translates directly into reliable, on\-time, mission\-critical delivery. Use these signals — adherence, automation rate, and service\-level performance — to continuously identify what to refine next.

  


**Requirements**
----------------


* 2–4\+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation, systems configuration, business analysis, or a comparable role that bridges customer requirements and a technical platform.
* **A proven background taking complicated SOPs and parsing them into actionable process flow diagrams or structured workflows is highly desired.**
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you naturally bring structure to complexity and don't let edge cases slip through.
* Experience governing processes that encourages adoption without proliferation
* Comfort working with structured data and configuration logic (e.g., JSON, rules engines, conditional/branching logic). You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read, reason about, and build logical rule structures confidently.
* Strong communication and requirements\-gathering skills, with the ability to interview stakeholders and customers to surface the real process beneath a written SOP.
* Familiarity with process\-mapping tools (e.g., BPMN, Lucidchart, Visio) is a plus.
* Logistics, supply chain, or operations experience preferred but not required — we'll help you build domain expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  


**Role Details**
----------------


**Department:** R\&D


**Team:** No direct reports initially; you'll collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations, onboarding, and account management. This position will likely grow into an org so manager aspirations are a plus.


**Location:** Carlsbad, CA preferred. Open to remote in the US

  


**Success Metrics**
-------------------


**2026:** Independently own end\-to\-end workflow configuration for new customer onboardings; deliver accurate, on\-time workflow and mobile configurations with minimal field defects. Establish plan to increase company autopilot KPIs and demonstrate ability in one sector.


**2027:** Dramatic increases in autopilot metrics across all sectors.

  


**Your First 90 Days**
----------------------



Build relationships across onboarding, operations, and product; develop deep fluency in Airspace's workflow engine, JSON workflow schema, and mobile configuration tools; shadow customer onboardings; and configure and ship your first customer workflow under guidance.


**Your First 180 Days**
-----------------------



Independently own workflow governance and mobile configuration for new customer onboardings, translate complex SOPs into production\-ready workflows with high accuracy, and begin building reusable components and templates that improve configuration speed and consistency.

  


**Compensation**
----------------


**Salary range:** $88K\-$115K. Base salary is determined by factors such as experience and location.

  


* High\-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
* Open PTO
* 401K with company match

### **Core Values:**


* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.


### **About Airspace:**



From life\-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world's largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time\-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI\-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind\- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time\-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world\-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper\-focused on the needs of our customers and team members.



With offices in the United States in Carlsbad, CA and in Europe in Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Stockholm, and London, we are rapidly scaling into new markets and industries while continuing to innovate and maximize value for our customers. Backed by leading investors including Telstra, HarbourVest, Prologis, Qualcomm, Defy, and others, Airspace has raised $140M to date.



Join our team of 300\+ technologists, futurists, and industry veterans as we work as One Team to revolutionize time\-critical logistics.

  



Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E\-Verify program for all locations.  




*For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.*

**Company Introduction:**



Airspace is a tech\-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.



As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission\-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.


Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers, listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies, and featured as an Innovation and Disruption leader by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.



The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time\-critical logistics.

**Engineer the Workflows Behind Mission\-Critical Deliveries**
--------------------------------------------------------------



Airspace delivers service levels that no team could achieve on manual effort alone. Our platform is what makes that possible — a mature, deeply capable system that encodes exactly how, when, and under what conditions every order activity should happen. The more faithfully that technology reflects the real\-world needs of each customer, the more our people are freed to do what they do best: execute flawlessly when failure is not an option.

  



We're looking for a **Solutions Engineer** to join our R\&D team and own that translation layer between the customer and the platform. You'll take complex, real\-world customer Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and turn them into precise, custom workflows inside our core system — software defined workflows that govern the rules and timing of every order activity. You'll also configure the mobile workflows our drivers follow in the field, ensuring that every customer\-specified action is performed correctly, every time.

  


**This is a role for someone who finds deep satisfaction in taking something ambiguous and complicated and making it exact.**

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Partner Across Customers and Internal Teams**



Work closely with onboarding, operations, account management, and product to gather requirements, clarify ambiguity in customer SOPs, and validate that configured workflows reflect real operational intent. Serve as the bridge between what a customer says they need and how the platform delivers it.


### **Translate Customer SOPs into Intelligent Workflows**



Take detailed, often complex customer SOPs and parse them into highly accurate, custom workflows within Airspace's core platform. Build and maintain the JSON\-defined workflow diagrams that specify all the business rules for a customer — including which order activities occur, when they're triggered, and under what conditions. Own the accuracy and completeness of these configurations end to end.


### **Configure Field \& Mobile Driver Workflows**



Configure the mobile workflows that guide drivers through customer\-specific activities in the field. Ensure that every required step — captures, scans, confirmations, exception handling — is presented correctly and in the right sequence, so that what happens on the ground matches exactly what the customer expects.


### **Maintain, Test, and Evolve Configurations**



Rigorously test and validate workflows before they go live, and iterate as customer requirements change over time. Catch edge cases before they become field problems, and continuously improve the reliability of the configurations you own.


### **Build for Scale and Reuse**



Identify common patterns across customers and verticals, and design reusable workflow components and templates that reduce configuration time and increase consistency. Help shape the tooling, standards, and best practices that make workflow configuration faster and more reliable as Airspace scales.


### **Measure and Drive Workflow Impact**



Own the metrics that prove your configurations are working as intended. Track how faithfully operations adhere to the workflows you've built — surfacing where reality diverges from the configured procedure and feeding that back into better configurations. Drive up the share of orders that run on auto\-pilot, where the platform executes the right activities at the right time without manual intervention. And monitor service levels across orders governed by Task Workflows, ensuring that the precision of your configurations translates directly into reliable, on\-time, mission\-critical delivery. Use these signals — adherence, automation rate, and service\-level performance — to continuously identify what to refine next.

  


**Requirements**
----------------


* 2–4\+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation, systems configuration, business analysis, or a comparable role that bridges customer requirements and a technical platform.
* **A proven background taking complicated SOPs and parsing them into actionable process flow diagrams or structured workflows is highly desired.**
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you naturally bring structure to complexity and don't let edge cases slip through.
* Experience governing processes that encourages adoption without proliferation
* Comfort working with structured data and configuration logic (e.g., JSON, rules engines, conditional/branching logic). You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read, reason about, and build logical rule structures confidently.
* Strong communication and requirements\-gathering skills, with the ability to interview stakeholders and customers to surface the real process beneath a written SOP.
* Familiarity with process\-mapping tools (e.g., BPMN, Lucidchart, Visio) is a plus.
* Logistics, supply chain, or operations experience preferred but not required — we'll help you build domain expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  


**Role Details**
----------------


**Department:** R\&D


**Team:** No direct reports initially; you'll collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations, onboarding, and account management. This position will likely grow into an org so manager aspirations are a plus.


**Location:** Carlsbad, CA preferred. Open to remote in the US

  


**Success Metrics**
-------------------


**2026:** Independently own end\-to\-end workflow configuration for new customer onboardings; deliver accurate, on\-time workflow and mobile configurations with minimal field defects. Establish plan to increase company autopilot KPIs and demonstrate ability in one sector.


**2027:** Dramatic increases in autopilot metrics across all sectors.

  


**Your First 90 Days**
----------------------



Build relationships across onboarding, operations, and product; develop deep fluency in Airspace's workflow engine, JSON workflow schema, and mobile configuration tools; shadow customer onboardings; and configure and ship your first customer workflow under guidance.


**Your First 180 Days**
-----------------------



Independently own workflow governance and mobile configuration for new customer onboardings, translate complex SOPs into production\-ready workflows with high accuracy, and begin building reusable components and templates that improve configuration speed and consistency.

  


**Compensation**
----------------


**Salary range:** $88K\-$115K. Base salary is determined by factors such as experience and location.

  


* High\-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
* Open PTO
* 401K with company match

### **Core Values:**


* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.


### **About Airspace:**



From life\-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world's largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time\-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI\-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind\- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time\-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world\-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper\-focused on the needs of our customers and team members.



With offices in the United States in Carlsbad, CA and in Europe in Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Stockholm, and London, we are rapidly scaling into new markets and industries while continuing to innovate and maximize value for our customers. Backed by leading investors including Telstra, HarbourVest, Prologis, Qualcomm, Defy, and others, Airspace has raised $140M to date.



Join our team of 300\+ technologists, futurists, and industry veterans as we work as One Team to revolutionize time\-critical logistics.

  



Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E\-Verify program for all locations.  




*For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.*
