**About the team**
------------------

Zillow Media Experts is seeking experienced photographers for part\-time real estate media work in Riverside, CA. Apply your photography skills to the Real Estate industry, capturing high quality photos, videos and Zillow's 3D interactive floor plans to help real estate agents professionally market listings. By working with us you’ll be at the forefront of Real Estate media innovation, capturing media that consumers want to see when shopping for a home. Zillow Media Expert photographers will be expected to drive between job sites in their market area, capture media, and successfully cull and upload media.
**About the role**
------------------

This is a part\-time position in **Riverside, CA** **.** Photographers in this role will typically work 10\-20 hours per week, depending on their location and business needs. During periods of high demand, Photographers may occasionally be asked to work more than 20 hours per week. While this is a part\-time position, there may be opportunities for full\-time employment in the future.


As a Photographer supporting Zillow Media Experts and our Listing Media Services, you will:


* Capture industry\-leading, professional still photography, listing videos, 3D or 360° virtual tours, drone photography \& videos (depending on a business need), and social media videos for for\-sale or for\-rent properties
* Utilize advanced photography techniques and equipment to showcase the unique features and aesthetics of each property, allowing sellers and real estate agents to market their listing in the best light
* Coordinate and interact with clients on\-site to understand their specific photography needs and expectations
* Provide guidance and direction to clients and property owners during photography sessions to achieve desired results and maximize the visual impact of images
* Use cutting\-edge proprietary technology to create captivating rich media experiences
* Ensure that all photographs adhere to brand guidelines and represent properties accurately and attractively
* Manage and maintain photography equipment, including cameras, lenses, and accessories, to ensure optimal performance and reliability
* Organize and upload captured media for post\-processing, meeting all deadlines and appointment punctuality, and adhering to availability guidelines.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in real estate photography to continually improve skills and techniques
* Develop creative concepts and ideas for photography to effectively showcase the unique selling points of each property
* Collaborate with other team members such as Regional Managers, Market Leaders, and photographers as well as external partners such as real estate agents and marketing professionals to deliver cohesive visual assets for marketing campaigns and promotional materials
* Adapt to future media, product, service, capture, or processing changes
* Represent Zillow Media Experts in a professional manner

This role has been categorized as a Field position. “Field” employees perform the majority of their work in a specified geographic location set by their management team. Employees are expected to live within a reasonable commuting distance to their region and/or service area. ZG has not defined a reasonable distance and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications regarding time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $24\.10 \- $38\.50 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $22\.90 \- $36\.50 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.
**Who you are**
---------------

* An experienced photographer with a talent for capturing high\-quality media (preferably within the real estate industry).
* Someone with excellent customer service \& professional business communication skills (you'll be engaging with the clients daily).
* A motivated, detail\-oriented person who can efficiently capture a home while maintaining the highest quality standards.
* A punctual professional who always shows up on time and delivers captured media by communicated deadlines.
* An independent worker, comfortable working solo.

**Requirements**

* The ability to learn Zillow Media Expert’s processes and computer systems.
* Experience capturing high\-quality photography, preferably exterior and interior real estate photos, real estate videos, 3D tours, and drone media.
* Deep understanding of photography fundamentals using DSLR/Mirrorless systems.
* May be expected to obtain an FAA Part 107 drone license, complete drone training, and safely operate a drone in accordance with FAA, based on business need.
* Possession of a valid driver's license
* Operate and maintain and/or procure reliable transportation
* Ability to drive within a 60\+ mile radius of City Center.
* Ability to provide a minimum of 20 hours per week of availability. While this is to allow for scheduling flexibility, please note part\-time photographers typically work less than 20 hours per week on average.
* Internet upload speed of at least 15 Mbps is strongly preferred.
* Located near **Riverside, CA**

Required Equipment


* A professional full frame or crop sensor DSLR/mirrorless camera with the ability to shoot 5 brackets, Auto Exposure Bracketing ‘AEB’. (ex: Canon R7, R5, 6DmkII, 5DmkIV)
* Wide\-angle zoom lens *(ex: Full Frame \- 15\-35mm, Crop Sensor \- 10\-22mm* )
* Ball Head or Geared Head Tripod (Video Fluid Head Tripods are not acceptable)

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025 , and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.  



  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

**About the team**
------------------

Zillow Media Experts is seeking experienced photographers for part\-time real estate media work in Long Island, NY. Apply your photography skills to the Real Estate industry, capturing high quality photos, videos and Zillow's 3D interactive floor plans to help real estate agents professionally market listings. By working with us you’ll be at the forefront of Real Estate media innovation, capturing media that consumers want to see when shopping for a home. Zillow Media Expert photographers will be expected to drive between job sites in their market area, capture media, and successfully cull and upload media.
**About the role**
------------------

This is a part\-time position in **Long Island, NY** **.** Photographers in this role will typically work 10\-20 hours per week, depending on their location and business needs. During periods of high demand, Photographers may occasionally be asked to work more than 20 hours per week. While this is a part\-time position, there may be opportunities for full\-time employment in the future.


As a Photographer supporting Zillow Media Experts and our Listing Media Services, you will:


* Capture industry\-leading, professional still photography, listing videos, 3D or 360° virtual tours, drone photography \& videos (depending on a business need), and social media videos for for\-sale or for\-rent properties
* Utilize advanced photography techniques and equipment to showcase the unique features and aesthetics of each property, allowing sellers and real estate agents to market their listing in the best light
* Coordinate and interact with clients on\-site to understand their specific photography needs and expectations
* Provide guidance and direction to clients and property owners during photography sessions to achieve desired results and maximize the visual impact of images
* Use cutting\-edge proprietary technology to create captivating rich media experiences
* Ensure that all photographs adhere to brand guidelines and represent properties accurately and attractively
* Manage and maintain photography equipment, including cameras, lenses, and accessories, to ensure optimal performance and reliability
* Organize and upload captured media for post\-processing, meeting all deadlines and appointment punctuality, and adhering to availability guidelines.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in real estate photography to continually improve skills and techniques
* Develop creative concepts and ideas for photography to effectively showcase the unique selling points of each property
* Collaborate with other team members such as Regional Managers, Market Leaders, and photographers as well as external partners such as real estate agents and marketing professionals to deliver cohesive visual assets for marketing campaigns and promotional materials
* Adapt to future media, product, service, capture, or processing changes
* Represent Zillow Media Experts in a professional manner

This role has been categorized as a Field position. “Field” employees perform the majority of their work in a specified geographic location set by their management team. Employees are expected to live within a reasonable commuting distance to their region and/or service area. ZG has not defined a reasonable distance and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications regarding time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $24\.10 \- $38\.50 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $22\.90 \- $36\.50 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.
**Who you are**
---------------

* An experienced photographer with a talent for capturing high\-quality media (preferably within the real estate industry).
* Someone with excellent customer service \& professional business communication skills (you'll be engaging with the clients daily).
* A motivated, detail\-oriented person who can efficiently capture a home while maintaining the highest quality standards.
* A punctual professional who always shows up on time and delivers captured media by communicated deadlines.
* An independent worker, comfortable working solo.

**Requirements**

* The ability to learn Zillow Media Expert’s processes and computer systems.
* Experience capturing high\-quality photography, preferably exterior and interior real estate photos, real estate videos, 3D tours, and drone media.
* Deep understanding of photography fundamentals using DSLR/Mirrorless systems.
* May be expected to obtain an FAA Part 107 drone license, complete drone training, and safely operate a drone in accordance with FAA, based on business need.
* Possession of a valid driver's license
* Operate and maintain and/or procure reliable transportation
* Ability to drive within a 60\+ mile radius of City Center.
* Ability to provide a minimum of 20 hours per week of availability. While this is to allow for scheduling flexibility, please note part\-time photographers typically work less than 20 hours per week on average.
* Internet upload speed of at least 15 Mbps is strongly preferred.
* Located near **Long Island, NY**

**Required Equipment**

* A professional full frame or crop sensor DSLR/mirrorless camera with the ability to shoot 5 brackets, Auto Exposure Bracketing ‘AEB’. (ex: Canon R7, R5, 6DmkII, 5DmkIV)
* Wide\-angle zoom lens *(ex: Full Frame \- 15\-35mm, Crop Sensor \- 10\-22mm* )
* Ball Head or Geared Head Tripod (Video Fluid Head Tripods are not acceptable)

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025 , and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.  



  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

**Job Description:**


Dentsu Creative's Motion Team is looking for a mid\-level Motion Designer. You'll work in a highly creative environment, across campaign, brand, and social content — concepting and delivering motion design for some of the biggest brands in the world. Your primary focus will be one of the most recognized names on the planet — a marquee client we can only reveal once you're in the room. Working closely with other creative thinkers, you'll put animation principles and visual storytelling into practice to bring ideas and concepts to life through motion. You'll own your projects, build systems that help the team move faster, and be comfortable leading your own work in a fast\-paced agency environment.


This role is to be based in our NYC office and be on\-site at least 3 days/week.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own motion projects end\-to\-end** — from concept and pitch through design, animation, and final delivery
* **Collaborate with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Producers, and Project Managers** to deliver on\-brand, on\-time work
* **Build and maintain reusable templates, motion systems, and toolkits** that improve team speed and consistency
* **Design for platform** — Be versed in best\-practices to deliver content designed and optimized for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, paid social, and other channels
* **Manage multiple projects with shifting deadlines** without sacrificing quality
* **Source and mix music and sound** for motion deliverables
* **Maintain brand consistency** across all work in line with client guidelines
* **Contribute to the team's creative culture** — share ideas, give feedback, help improve how we work

### **Requirements**

* **3–5 years of professional experience** as a motion designer, ideally in an agency, studio, or in\-house creative team
* **Strong portfolio/reel** showing range across social, campaign, and brand work — we want to see design thinking, not just keyframes
* **Expert\-level After Effects** — including expressions, shape layer animation, and familiarity with the plugin ecosystem
* **Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro**
* **Strong graphic design and typography skills** — you should be able to design a beautiful frame before you animate it
* **Combining live\-action footage and motion design** should be second nature
* **Working knowledge of Cinema 4D or Blender** — enough to bring 3D elements into motion work (not a VFX role, but 3D literacy is expected in 2026\)
* **Understanding of social platforms**, trends, specs, and what makes content perform
* **Basic audio editing** — syncing sound to motion, mixing, selecting music
* **Disciplined file organization** — clean project files, consistent naming conventions, and handoff\-ready file management
* **Clear communicator** — can present work, take feedback constructively, and articulate design decisions to clients and teams

### **AI in Your Workflow**

**AI is being integrated into our workflows**. We expect you to be actively using it, not just aware of it.

* **Use AI tools to speed up your process** — generating references, iterating on concepts, exploring layouts, streamlining repetitive tasks. Tools like Google VEO, Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, Claude, Copilot and others. are evolving fast. Stay curious and share what works.
* **Your design eye, animation instincts, and storytelling are what matter most.** AI helps you move faster — it doesn't replace taste and craft.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with Figma, Rive, or Lottie for web/interactive motion
* After Effects scripting (ExtendScript, JSX)
* Experience building motion systems or templates at scale

### **What This Role Isn't**

* This is **not a VFX\-heavy role** — if your reel is mostly compositing, particles, and simulation, this probably isn't the right fit
* This is a role for a designer\-animator hybrid who loves moving between campaign and social work, collaborates well, and wants to help build something great


\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS5

**Additional Information**


At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in\-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.


The annual salary range for this position is $71,875 \- $85,000\. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.


Benefits available with this position include:


* Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
* Life insurance,
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance,
* 401k,
* Flexible paid time off,
* At least 15 paid holidays per year,
* Paid sick and safe leave, and
* Paid parental leave.


Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.


To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. We are unapologetic about who we are and what we’re after—bringing innovation and inspiration to every athlete\* in the world. The annual base salary for this position ranges from $160,300\.00 in our lowest geographic market to $338,200\.00 in our highest geographic market. Actual salary will vary based on a candidate's location, qualifications, skills and experience.
  
  

Information about benefits can be found here.
  
  

Director, Art Direction West, North America
  
  

North America Brand Creative, LAHQ Studio
  
  

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  

You will work and report to the Senior Creative Director of Nike NA Brand creative studio, collaborating daily with your creative teammates from the experience, narrative, and retail teams to answer seasonal briefs from various brand marketing categories, including Lifestyle, Global Football, Basketball, Running, etc.
  
  

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

The Director, Art Direction for North America Brand Creative leads multidisciplinary teams across multiple projects, partnering with senior leadership, creative directors, experience directors, narrative leads, studio managers, and producers to deliver innovative, well\-crafted creative work. You champion design excellence across mediums, ensuring every output reflects Nike’s commitment to performance, product innovation, athlete storytelling, and cultural relevance. You will present to senior leadership with clarity and confidence, while coaching and developing emerging designers. You bring a deep connection to contemporary culture—sport, design, art, fashion, youth culture—and use this awareness to drive breakthrough ideas.
  
  

10\+ years of experience in product, brand, or marketing within a major brand or agency
  
Bachelor’s degree in design or related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education and experience, and training.
  
Deep passion and knowledge of North American sport, athletes, and the cultural landscape.
  
Ability to evolve and elevate North America and LA focused art direction in partnership with the creative team.
  
Lead, inspire, and coach young designers, fostering growth and creative excellence.
  
Build visual worlds and deliver best\-in\-class art direction for campaigns rooted in sport, athlete\-entertainer storytelling, and product innovation.
  
Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of high\-quality creative work from concept through final execution.
  
Present creative concepts with strong storytelling, clarity, and stage presence.
  
Maintain uncompromising standards of quality, consistency, and innovation.
  
Highly proficient in design, typography, image\-making, and retouching using Adobe Creative Suite and tools such as Figma. 3D or motion knowledge is a plus.
  
Cultivate strong relationships with external creative partners—agencies, photographers, directors, 3D artists, designers, animators, writers, illustrators, and more.
  
Stay ahead of trends across sport, fashion, subculture, music, design, retail, film, technology, AI, and social media to ensure creative relevance.
  
  

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
  
  

You will lead art direction for Nike North America, partnering with senior leadership to shape and deliver the region’s visual identity. You’ll guide design teams across mediums—visual systems, campaigns, photography, film, digital, and experiential—ensuring all work reflects Nike’s innovation, diversity, and cultural relevance.
  
  

Develop, refine, and deliver multiple visual directions system for North America and LA in partnership with senior creative leaders.
  
Drive NA art direction with design teams through inspiration, execution, mentorship, and clear creative guidance.
  
Deliver outstanding concepts, visual centres, project guidelines, photography, film content, digital design, social assets, and consumer experiences.
  
**Build and maintain relationships with top creative partners:** agencies, photographers, filmmakers, illustrators, typographers, designers, 3D artists, writers, and more
  
Partner with cross\-functional leaders to strategically identify and manage external creative talents.
  
Define and elevate art direction for NA video and photography across categories, ensuring work is on\-brand, diverse, culturally resonant, and fiscally responsible.
  
Foster a culture of creative “firsts” and breakthrough thinking.
  
Stay current with trends in sport, fashion, design, art, film, culture, media, and technology.
  
Collaborate closely with Brand Voice, Photography, Styling, Marketing, Digital, Retail, Product Design, and Concepts teams throughout the creative process.
  
Ensure all projects are well\-planned, creatively exceptional, and delivered on time.
  
Support talent development through coaching, feedback, and performance management
  
  

We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in\-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form.
  
  

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.
  
  

What You Can Expect
  
OUR HIRING GAME PLAN
  
01 Apply
  
  

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.
  
  

02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment
  
  

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10\-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world\-class service and what makes you unique.

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

**About Mainstay Digital**

We create high\-end 3D experiences for B2B clients, from interactive videos and 3D product animations to AR demos and product stills. Our work helps technical sales teams showcase complex products in immersive, accessible ways.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a 3D generalist with the instincts of an animator and a storyteller — someone who can take a storyboard and carry it through the entire production process on their own.

You'll own the full arc of a piece: starting from a storyboard, building it into a boardomatic, developing it into a full animatic, then taking it all the way through to final animation, lighting and render setups, editing, and motion graphics. This is a role for someone who thinks in terms of pacing, composition, and narrative — not just technical execution — and who can make strong creative calls without needing every beat directed.

This is project\-based contract work for an experienced generalist who can own the pipeline from brief to delivery with minimal direction.

**What We Need**

A 3D generalist / animator who can:

* Take a storyboard and develop it into a boardomatic, then a full animatic
* Carry a piece through to final animation with strong sense of timing, staging, and storytelling
* Handle lighting and render setups end\-to\-end
* Finish the piece through editing and motion graphics
* Make strong visual and narrative decisions independently (composition, pacing, storytelling, design)
* Communicate proactively, flag issues early, and meet deadlines consistently

**Requirements**

* Several years of professional 3D and animation experience (studio, agency, or freelance)
* **Expert\-level Blender workflow** — all 3D work is done in Blender
* **Senior\-level proficiency across the Adobe suite** (After Effects, Premiere Pro) for editing and motion graphics
* Demonstrated storytelling and animation instincts — pacing, staging, composition
* Proven track record delivering finished, narrative\-driven pieces end\-to\-end and independently
* **A portfolio that includes actual videos** — finished, moving work. Stills alone will not be considered for this role. Please note your specific role on each piece.

**Bonus Skills**

* Storyboarding or boardomatic/previs experience
* Sound and music editing to picture
* Real\-time engine experience (Unity)

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* A brief intro explaining why you're a great fit, with emphasis on your storytelling and animation strengths
* Your portfolio **including actual video work**, with your role on each piece clearly noted
* Any relevant motion graphics, previs, or automation experience

**Contract Details**

This is an independent contractor position, not full\-time employment. Work is project\-based with strong potential for ongoing collaboration. We have a steady pipeline of projects and are looking for long\-term relationships with reliable talent. You'll work within our pipeline by remoting into our machines, so no need to provide your own software or hardware.

Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Walk us through a project you took from storyboard all the way to final delivery. How did you handle the progression from boardomatic to animatic to final animation?
* How do you approach storytelling and pacing in your animation work? What makes a piece land for you beyond technical polish?
* Describe your proficiency with Blender for animation, lighting, and rendering, and with the Adobe suite (After Effects, Premiere Pro) for editing and motion graphics.
* Are you comfortable working remotely by connecting to a client's machine and working within an established pipeline and file structure? Please describe any similar remote workflow experience you've had.

$15–$25 per hour, as listed in the job posting. Can you confirm that this range is acceptable to you?

At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1\.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3\.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.**Job Title:**


Information Graphics Editor \- Client Services, Strategic Capital**Company:**


Prologis

**A day in****the life**


At Prologis, we sit at the intersection of global trade, logistics, supply chains, e\-commerce, energy and sustainability. Through our global operating platform, customer relationships and industry\-leading research organization, we have a unique perspective on the forces shaping the global economy.

  

Strategic Capital, our private capital business with $102 billion in assets under management across 17 countries and 11 private funds, depends on clear, accurate and compelling communication to help investors understand those trends.

  

We are looking for an Information Graphics Editor to help define how those stories are told.


Understanding that communication with data is different from other types of graphic design, this role is fully dedicated to information design. Your primary focus will be creating charts, maps, tables and information graphics that transform complex ideas into visual explanations that are clear, insightful and trustworthy.

  

You will work closely with subject matter experts to help explain topics ranging from global trade and supply chains to sustainability, energy, capital markets and logistics real estate. Your role is not simply to visualize data, it is to help people understand it.

  

This role will partner with our Lead Designer to ensure quantitative and qualitative storytelling work together seamlessly across presentations, reports, email and investor communications.


Unlike many corporate design roles, you will have the opportunity to focus deeply on the craft of information design while helping establish the standards, systems and workflows that make our graphics more consistent, more scalable and easier to produce.

  

We are equally interested in preserving craftsmanship and exploring innovation. This role will help shape where emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can improve efficiency and where thoughtful human judgment and accuracy remains essential.

 **Key responsibilities****include:**

* Design and produce charts, graphs, tables, maps and information graphics across Strategic Capital presentations, reports and investor communications
* Translate complex quantitative information into clear, accurate and engaging visual narratives
* Evolve the visual language of Strategic Capital's information graphics so every visualization complements the Prologis brand while remaining clear, consistent and immediately understandable
* Partner with subject matter experts to identify the most effective way to communicate complex ideas visually

We're looking for a creative, strategic, and highly skilled **In\-House Designer \& Visual Content Creator** who lives and breathes branding, visual storytelling, and premium content creation.

This is more than a design role — we're looking for someone who can assist us shape how our brand is seen, felt, and remembered. You'll be responsible for bringing our brand to life through thoughtful design, cinematic content, and compelling visual communication that sets us apart.

**What You'll Do**

* Create our visual brand identity across all digital platforms.
* Plan, conceptualize, shoot, edit, and publish high\-quality social media content.
* Create cinematic videos with clean, modern aesthetics and strong storytelling.
* Design engaging graphics, campaigns, and marketing assets aligned with our brand.
* Develop content strategies that support business objectives and audience growth.
* Ensure every piece of content communicates our brand consistently and professionally.
* Stay ahead of design, social media, and content trends while maintaining a distinctive brand identity.
* Collaborate with internal teams to bring ideas to life from concept through execution.
* Build content that is intentional, strategic, and designed to create lasting impact—not just follow trends.

**What We're Looking For**

* Someone from the area; **MUST** be mobile to get to our location
* Strong background in **branding, graphic design, and visual communication.**
* Exceptional videography and video editing skills.
* A portfolio showcasing premium branding work, cinematic content, and creative storytelling.
* Strong understanding of composition, lighting, colour, typography, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience creating content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other social platforms.
* Ability to think strategically about content, ensuring every post has purpose and aligns with brand goals.
* Self\-motivated, organised, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* A creative eye with exceptional attention to detail.
* Passion for creating work that is polished, sophisticated, and memorable.

**Bonus Points**

* Photography experience.
* Motion graphics and animation skills.
* Experience building and evolving premium brand identities.
* Knowledge of social media analytics and performance\-driven content strategies.

**What Success Looks Like**

We're looking for someone who creates content that people stop scrolling for. Every design, video, and campaign should elevate our brand, communicate with intention, and leave a lasting impression. Your work should be visually striking, strategically driven, and unmistakably ours.

**To Apply:** Please send your CV, portfolio, and links to your social media work or showreel. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Pay: $14\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Who is Blueprint?**



We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States. Unified by a shared passion for solving complicated problems, our people are our greatest asset. We use technology as a tool to bridge the gap between strategy and execution, powered by the knowledge, skills, and the expertise of our teams, who all have unique perspectives and years of experience across multiple industries. We're bold, smart, agile, and fun.


**What does Blueprint do?**



Blueprint helps organizations unlock value from existing assets by leveraging cutting\-edge technology to create additional revenue streams and new lines of business. We connect strategy, business solutions, products, and services to transform and grow companies.


**Why Blueprint?**



At Blueprint, we believe in the power of possibility and are passionate about bringing it to life. Whether you join our bustling product division, our multifaceted services team or you want to grow your career in human resources, your ability to make an impact is amplified when you join one of our teams. You'll focus on solving unique business problems while gaining hands\-on experience with the world's best technology. We believe in unique perspectives and build teams of people with diverse skillsets and backgrounds. At Blueprint, you'll have the opportunity to work with multiple clients and teams, such as data science and product development, all while learning, growing, and developing new solutions. We guarantee you won't find a better place to work and thrive than at Blueprint.

### **In This Role**



As a Motion Designer, you will create, edit, and enhance high\-quality video and motion graphics assets that support customer\-facing, marketing, social media, and digital experiences. You will transform raw footage, product demonstrations, and creative concepts into compelling visual stories that engage audiences and clearly communicate key messages. This role requires a combination of strong motion design expertise, video editing skills, visual storytelling ability, and production discipline. Success in this position depends on delivering polished creative assets while managing project timelines, file organization, version control, and stakeholder feedback in a fast\-paced production environment.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


### **Motion Design \& Video Creation**


* Create high\-quality motion graphics, animations, video edits, and visual treatments for customer\-facing, marketing, and social media content.
* Translate product narratives, creative concepts, and source materials into engaging motion and video assets.
* Develop polished visual content that supports storytelling, product education, and audience engagement.
* Edit and refine content to improve pacing, clarity, visual appeal, and overall effectiveness.

### **Video Editing \& Post\-Production**


* Edit raw footage, screen captures, demonstrations, animations, and visual assets into finished video content.
* Apply motion effects, transitions, typography, color correction, audio synchronization, and other finishing elements to meet quality standards.
* Prepare deliverables across multiple formats, channels, aspect ratios, and platforms.
* Ensure all final assets are accurate, brand\-compliant, accessible, and ready for stakeholder review or publication.

### **Design Quality \& Brand Execution**


* Apply strong visual design principles across composition, typography, timing, pacing, hierarchy, and storytelling.
* Maintain consistency with established brand standards and creative direction.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer understanding and engagement through thoughtful motion design and editing decisions.
* Balance creative excellence with project timelines, production requirements, and business objectives.

### **Production Management \& Workflow**


* Manage file organization, naming conventions, version control, asset tracking, and delivery processes.
* Maintain production timelines, milestones, schedules, and status updates across multiple projects.
* Track revisions, approvals, stakeholder feedback, and final deliverables.
* Communicate risks, blockers, dependencies, and timeline changes proactively.

### **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Support**


* Partner with design, product, marketing, and business stakeholders to understand project goals and requirements.
* Communicate project status, timelines, deliverables, and challenges effectively.
* Prepare design explorations, revised cuts, and final assets for stakeholder review.
* Contribute creative recommendations that improve storytelling, customer understanding, and overall content performance.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent projects.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Motion Design, Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Film/Video Production, Digital Media, Studio Art/Fine Art, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of professional experience in motion design, video editing, or digital content production.
* Advanced proficiency with Adobe After Effects and/or Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Experience with Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
* Experience using productivity and collaboration tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and AI\-assisted workplace technologies.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating:
	+ Motion graphics
	+ Video editing
	+ Visual storytelling
	+ High\-quality production execution
* Experience creating motion and video content for marketing, social media, customer\-facing, digital, or product\-related initiatives.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ Motion design principles
	+ Typography
	+ Visual hierarchy
	+ Composition
	+ Pacing and timing
	+ Brand consistency
* Experience managing file organization, naming conventions, version control, production schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience creating motion graphics or video content within technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or productivity\-focused environments.
* Knowledge of video accessibility best practices, including:
	+ Captioning
	+ Readability
	+ Color contrast
	+ Clear visual communication
* Experience working in structured production environments with formal review processes, approval workflows, and stakeholder feedback cycles.
* Demonstrated success balancing creative execution with operational and production management responsibilities.


**Salary Range**



At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is **$35– $40 USD/Hourly.** Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate's qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, orientation, veteran/military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital, or familial status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other status protected by law.



If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please reach out to: recruiting@bpcs.com



Blueprint believe in the importance of a healthy and happy team, which is why our comprehensive benefits package includes:


* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Account
* 401k program
* Competitive PTO offerings
* Parental Leave
* Opportunities for professional growth and development

Village Marketing, part of WPP, is an advocacy\-based marketing shop that builds brands through people. Traditional marketing focuses on positioning brands in the minds of consumers. We focus on positioning brands in the lives of consumers. It's a shift from promotion to advocacy. From audience to community. From transaction to relationship. And from message to conversation. We leverage creators who live and work in the social space throughout every step of our process.



Sample clients: Boll \& Branch, The Coca\-Cola Company, Ford, Nike, HelloFresh, Hellmann's, AXE, Mackenzie\-Childs


**About WPP**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for an **Associate Director of Influencer** to support the strategic and operational leadership of our brand account. This role is designed for someone eager to expand their influence within the creator and experiential space while driving executional excellence across campaigns, events, and creator programs.



As a senior account management role, the Associate Director acts as both a client\-facing lead and an internal team manager, ensuring strategic alignment, seamless communication, and precision in delivery. The ideal candidate thrives in fast\-paced environments, is highly organized, and excels at bridging creative strategy with operational follow\-through.


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Strategy**


* Lead internal team brainstorming sessions for assigned campaigns to generate impactful and strategic ideas.
* Translate campaign strategy into actionable campaign plans and creative briefs, ensuring messaging and direction align with broader brand goals.
* Partner with the Director to develop bespoke influencer marketing strategies, rescopes, and upsells that align with client objectives.
* Provide strategic points of view on market trends, competitors, and audience behavior relevant to brand and audience.
* Maintain alignment between creative concepts, influencer activations, and campaign goals throughout execution.
* Lead campaign strategy development including approach, budget flighting, and storytelling frameworks.
* Leads online and offline creator programs, including brand activations (i.e. music festivals/creator trips), ensuring oversight of strategic direction without leading day\-to\-day execution.


**Influencer Management**


* Oversee outreach, vetting, contracting, and communication across assigned campaigns.
* Lead the full content lifecycle including briefing, deadlines, content reviews, and client delivery.
* Oversee influencer tracking documents and calendars to maintain clarity across deliverables and approval timelines.
* Partner with Legal to ensure contracts, deliverables, and usage rights are complete and compliant.
* Ensure influencers are on\-brand and that all content aligns with campaign messaging, creative intent, and performance goals.
* Lead paid plan development, ensuring that rates align with budget, strategy, and CPM benchmarks, and that partner selection ladders back to client objectives.
* Oversee predictive modeling based on performance data and identification of campaign benchmarks to inform future recommendations.


**Partnership \& Campaign Management**


* Lead negotiation of high\-reach paid partnerships using data and performance insights to inform decision\-making.
* Oversee influencer briefing materials, ensuring alignment with creative strategy and client goals.
* Manage celebrity briefings and ensure coordination between talent, creative, and client teams.
* Ensure timely influencer content reviews and approvals with clear, strategic feedback loops to the client and creators.


**Reporting \& Insights**


* Lead the development of campaign wrap reports and presentation decks with guidance from the Director.
* Oversee collection of performance data, engagement metrics, and qualitative feedback from creators and audiences.
* Build clear visuals and summaries that highlight campaign KPIs and insights.
* Drive the team to connect metrics and storytelling in alignment with client business objectives.
* Analyze campaign results to identify optimizations and elevate key insights and recommendations for future activations.


**Client Management**


* Act as the main point of contact for specific workstreams or activations, managing communication and expectations with mid\-level clients.
* Lead client kickoffs, campaign updates, and status meetings, ensuring clarity across deliverables and timelines.
* Anticipate client needs, proactively identifying roadblocks or concerns and presenting solutions to leadership.
* Communicate client feedback clearly to internal teams, ensuring action items are understood and implemented.
* Analyze client business goals and key performance pillars to position yourself as a trusted strategic partner.


**Team Management**


* Manage and mentor Senior Managers and Coordinators across assigned projects, fostering professional growth and accountability.
* Delegate tasks effectively and review for accuracy, alignment, and quality before delivery.
* Lead smaller internal workstreams or pods, managing communication, timelines, and priorities across functions.
* Oversee creation and updates of team DOLs, ensuring workload balance and alignment with team strengths and development areas.
* Lead regular check\-ins with your team to ensure deliverables are on track and resourcing is adequate.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with creative, media, legal, and talent teams to ensure seamless campaign execution.
* Flag bandwidth, resource, or performance challenges to the Director or Senior Director in a timely manner.


**Finance \& Billing**


* Support the Director and project managers with staffing grids, scopes, and budget trackers.
* Ensure campaign billing closures are accurate, with all numbers reconciled across documentation including accounts receipt sheet.
* Maintain oversight of billing trackers to ensure alignment with contracted scope, focusing on usage, reimbursable costs, and influencer fees.
* Review and validate all billing formulas and fees before submission to Accounting.
* Support Directors with quarterly financial reviews and campaign overviews.


**Legal \& Compliance**


* Manage contract creation and review for creators, ensuring accuracy and risk mitigation.
* Review all Manager and Senior Manager contracts and redlines for compliance and alignment with client guidelines.
* Escalate complex redline issues or legal concerns to senior leadership.
* Draft first\-pass SOW exhibits in partnership with leadership and Legal.


**Training \& Development**


* Lead onboarding and training for new Senior Managers joining the account.
* Support onboarding of new Associate Directors, ensuring alignment with account processes and client expectations.
* Assist in creating and refining onboarding materials and process documentation for team members, ensuring consistent training on client background, history, and goals.


**General Responsibilities**


* Ensure all projects and teams are operating within scope and deadlines, proactively identifying roadblocks and presenting solutions.
* Support new business efforts or special projects across clients as needed.
* Stay informed on cultural, platform, and influencer trends, and regularly share insights and POVs with the team.
* Uphold Village's values through collaboration, mentorship, and strong relationship\-building with both clients and colleagues.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* 5–7 years of experience in Marketing, Social Media, Partnerships, Influencer, and/or related fields.
* Proven experience managing teams and overseeing multiple accounts concurrently.
* Strong understanding of influencer marketing, paid partnerships, and campaign management.
* Experience with large\-scale programs or events preferred.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and time\-management skills.
* Fluency in Google Drive, Microsoft Office, and influencer or social analytics platforms.
* Passionate about mentorship, collaboration, and building strong client and team relationships.

  


**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE**


* You are a dependable and strategic partner to your clients, leading key workstreams with clarity and composure.
* Your team feels supported, guided, and motivated to deliver high\-quality work.
* Campaigns are executed with excellence, accuracy, and alignment to strategy.
* Reports and recaps reflect strong storytelling, actionable insights, and measurable business impact.
* You consistently model Village's core values: Do It Together, Do the Best Work of Our Lives, Do the Right Thing.

**About Ogilvy**



Ogilvy, part of WPP, has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture\-changing, value\-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity – innovating at the intersections of its advertising, public relations, relationship design, consulting, and health capabilities with experts collaborating seamlessly across over 120 offices in nearly 90 countries. Ogilvy currently ranks as the \#1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is a WPP company (NYSE: WPP). For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

  


**About WPP**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

**About Village Marketing**



Village Marketing, part of WPP, is an advocacy\-based marketing shop that builds brands through people. Traditional marketing focuses on positioning brands in the minds of consumers. We focus on positioning brands in the lives of consumers. It's a shift from promotion to advocacy. From audience to community. From transaction to relationship. And from message to conversation. We leverage creators who live and work in the social space throughout every step of our process.



Sample clients: Boll \& Branch, The Coca\-Cola Company, Ford, Nike, HelloFresh, Hellmann's, AXE, Mackenzie\-Childs


**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for an **Associate Director of Influencer** to support the strategic and operational leadership of our brand account. This role is designed for someone eager to expand their influence within the creator and experiential space while driving executional excellence across campaigns, events, and creator programs.



As a senior account management role, the Associate Director acts as both a client\-facing lead and an internal team manager, ensuring strategic alignment, seamless communication, and precision in delivery. The ideal candidate thrives in fast\-paced environments, is highly organized, and excels at bridging creative strategy with operational follow\-through.


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Strategy**


* Lead internal team brainstorming sessions for assigned campaigns to generate impactful and strategic ideas.
* Translate campaign strategy into actionable campaign plans and creative briefs, ensuring messaging and direction align with broader brand goals.
* Partner with the Director to develop bespoke influencer marketing strategies, rescopes, and upsells that align with client objectives.
* Provide strategic points of view on market trends, competitors, and audience behavior relevant to brand and audience.
* Maintain alignment between creative concepts, influencer activations, and campaign goals throughout execution.
* Lead campaign strategy development including approach, budget flighting, and storytelling frameworks.
* Leads online and offline creator programs, including brand activations (i.e. music festivals/creator trips), ensuring oversight of strategic direction without leading day\-to\-day execution.


**Influencer Management**


* Oversee outreach, vetting, contracting, and communication across assigned campaigns.
* Lead the full content lifecycle including briefing, deadlines, content reviews, and client delivery.
* Oversee influencer tracking documents and calendars to maintain clarity across deliverables and approval timelines.
* Partner with Legal to ensure contracts, deliverables, and usage rights are complete and compliant.
* Ensure influencers are on\-brand and that all content aligns with campaign messaging, creative intent, and performance goals.
* Lead paid plan development, ensuring that rates align with budget, strategy, and CPM benchmarks, and that partner selection ladders back to client objectives.
* Oversee predictive modeling based on performance data and identification of campaign benchmarks to inform future recommendations.


**Partnership \& Campaign Management**


* Lead negotiation of high\-reach paid partnerships using data and performance insights to inform decision\-making.
* Oversee influencer briefing materials, ensuring alignment with creative strategy and client goals.
* Manage celebrity briefings and ensure coordination between talent, creative, and client teams.
* Ensure timely influencer content reviews and approvals with clear, strategic feedback loops to the client and creators.


**Reporting \& Insights**


* Lead the development of campaign wrap reports and presentation decks with guidance from the Director.
* Oversee collection of performance data, engagement metrics, and qualitative feedback from creators and audiences.
* Build clear visuals and summaries that highlight campaign KPIs and insights.
* Drive the team to connect metrics and storytelling in alignment with client business objectives.
* Analyze campaign results to identify optimizations and elevate key insights and recommendations for future activations.


**Client Management**


* Act as the main point of contact for specific workstreams or activations, managing communication and expectations with mid\-level clients.
* Lead client kickoffs, campaign updates, and status meetings, ensuring clarity across deliverables and timelines.
* Anticipate client needs, proactively identifying roadblocks or concerns and presenting solutions to leadership.
* Communicate client feedback clearly to internal teams, ensuring action items are understood and implemented.
* Analyze client business goals and key performance pillars to position yourself as a trusted strategic partner.


**Team Management**


* Manage and mentor Senior Managers and Coordinators across assigned projects, fostering professional growth and accountability.
* Delegate tasks effectively and review for accuracy, alignment, and quality before delivery.
* Lead smaller internal workstreams or pods, managing communication, timelines, and priorities across functions.
* Oversee creation and updates of team DOLs, ensuring workload balance and alignment with team strengths and development areas.
* Lead regular check\-ins with your team to ensure deliverables are on track and resourcing is adequate.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with creative, media, legal, and talent teams to ensure seamless campaign execution.
* Flag bandwidth, resource, or performance challenges to the Director or Senior Director in a timely manner.


**Finance \& Billing**


* Support the Director and project managers with staffing grids, scopes, and budget trackers.
* Ensure campaign billing closures are accurate, with all numbers reconciled across documentation including accounts receipt sheet.
* Maintain oversight of billing trackers to ensure alignment with contracted scope, focusing on usage, reimbursable costs, and influencer fees.
* Review and validate all billing formulas and fees before submission to Accounting.
* Support Directors with quarterly financial reviews and campaign overviews.


**Legal \& Compliance**


* Manage contract creation and review for creators, ensuring accuracy and risk mitigation.
* Review all Manager and Senior Manager contracts and redlines for compliance and alignment with client guidelines.
* Escalate complex redline issues or legal concerns to senior leadership.
* Draft first\-pass SOW exhibits in partnership with leadership and Legal.


**Training \& Development**


* Lead onboarding and training for new Senior Managers joining the account.
* Support onboarding of new Associate Directors, ensuring alignment with account processes and client expectations.
* Assist in creating and refining onboarding materials and process documentation for team members, ensuring consistent training on client background, history, and goals.


**General Responsibilities**


* Ensure all projects and teams are operating within scope and deadlines, proactively identifying roadblocks and presenting solutions.
* Support new business efforts or special projects across clients as needed.
* Stay informed on cultural, platform, and influencer trends, and regularly share insights and POVs with the team.
* Uphold Village's values through collaboration, mentorship, and strong relationship\-building with both clients and colleagues.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* 5–7 years of experience in Marketing, Social Media, Partnerships, Influencer, and/or related fields.
* Proven experience managing teams and overseeing multiple accounts concurrently.
* Strong understanding of influencer marketing, paid partnerships, and campaign management.
* Experience with large\-scale programs or events preferred.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and time\-management skills.
* Fluency in Google Drive, Microsoft Office, and influencer or social analytics platforms.
* Passionate about mentorship, collaboration, and building strong client and team relationships.

  


**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE**


* You are a dependable and strategic partner to your clients, leading key workstreams with clarity and composure.
* Your team feels supported, guided, and motivated to deliver high\-quality work.
* Campaigns are executed with excellence, accuracy, and alignment to strategy.
* Reports and recaps reflect strong storytelling, actionable insights, and measurable business impact.
* You consistently model Village's core values: Do It Together, Do the Best Work of Our Lives, Do the Right Thing.

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose \- and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.



Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

* Self\-driven, positive and able to manage multiple projects at once

* Interest in influencer marketing and relationship management
* General understanding of the healthcare space, and willingness to learn more
* Self starter, articulate written \& verbal communication skills, social, adaptable
* Understanding of Excel, Shopify, CreatorIQ and other social reporting tools a plus


What you'll bring:


* 2\+ years of experience in social media and influencer marketing
* Experience with reporting on influencer marketing campaigns and related efforts
* Experience communicating clearly and effectively via email, phone and social media
* Proven work ethic and integrity
* Positive attitude
* Desire to excel and grow with FIGS
* Aspiration to create change and make an immediate impact
* Entrepreneurial spirit and egoless nature


**FIGS Compensation and Benefits**


*Pay Range*


* At FIGS, your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. This role's base salary range is between $70,000 and $75,000\. Actual base salary is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.


*Additional Compensation and Benefits*


* Equity: All FIGS employees have the opportunity to own shares of FIGS stock through our new\-hire equity program. Additionally, FIGS provides a discount when purchasing FIGS stock voluntarily through our FIGS Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* **Annual bonus: This position is eligible to participate in the FIGS annual bonus program**
* Other compensation and benefits offered include:
* + Comprehensive benefits and perks package focused on your well\-being, including premium medical, dental and vision coverage, and full access to wellness services through Breethe and Classpass. 100% FIGS\-sponsored life insurance and disability insurance
	+ Amazing 401(k) program, with a company match up to the first 6% of your contribution
	+ Generous paid time off \- We have 12 company holidays. For salaried team members, we offer flexible vacation. For our hourly team members, we offer up to 3 weeks of accrued vacation
	+ Meaningful time away for baby bonding, including parental leave, new parent care meals, and a transition back to work for primary caregivers
	+ FIGS sponsored Uber Eats voucher for in\-office weeks
	+ Personalized discount code for 50% off all FIGS products, along with a separate code to share with family and friends to enjoy a 25% discount site\-wide
	+ Access to FIGS Vet, Discounted Pet Daycare, Discounted Pet Insurance, and so much more…
* *Benefits eligibility is determined by hour requirements and length of service*

  


**A little bit about us…**



FIGS, Inc. is a founder\-led, direct\-to\-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We redefine what scrubs are by creating technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style, all at an affordable price. With the largest DTC platform in healthcare apparel, we sell our products to a rapidly growing community of loyal customers. Through these customer relationships, FIGS has built a community and lifestyle around a profession, revolutionizing the large and fragmented healthcare apparel market and becoming the industry's category\-defining healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand.



Our Threads for Threads initiative is integral to our mission to improve the lives of healthcare professionals on a global scale. Founded alongside FIGS in 2013, Threads for Threads donates scrubs to healthcare professionals working in resource\-poor countries around the world.

***FIGS considers all Qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories (e.g., arrests or conviction records), for Employment in accordance with applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.***

**A World\-Class Team**


BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.


We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

**Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s**


At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well\-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

**Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:**

* **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms.
* **Free BJ’s Memberships:** Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.\*
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.\*
* **Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits:** Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.\*
* **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan:** Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).\*
* **Employee Stock Purchase Plan:** Accumulate funds through after\-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.\*

* Eligibility requirements vary by position.


Position Summary  

The Copywriter is responsible for developing compelling creative concepts and on brand copy that support business objectives across multiple platforms. Working closely with art directors and project managers, this role requires bringing ideas to life through clear, engaging, and effective messaging.


Key Responsibilities

* Deliver copy and concepts that align to the approved creative brief, brand standards, and project requirements.
* Incorporate feedback to refine ideas, strengthen writing, and deliver work that is effective and aligned with campaign objectives.
* Execute projects and deliverables within established timelines.
* Collaborate with Art Directors to develop creative concepts.
* Engage, communicate and present ideas effectively in meetings providing meaningful input to drive collaboration and decision\-making.


Drive for Results

* Apply problem\-solving skills to achieve goals and overcome challenges
* Leverage insights, data and available information to develop effective creative
* Identify and communicate opportunities to improve creative work, and processes
* Enable on\-time execution while maintaining high quality standards
* Approach every project from a member perspective putting them first in everything we do


Leadership \& Collaboration

* Collaborate effectively with creative team and business partners
* Operate as a strong individual contributor while developing leadership skills
* Seek and apply constructive feedback to drive continuous improvement
* Demonstrate flexibility by shifting priorities and responding effectively to change
* Proactively seeks guidance that supports team improvement
* Contribute to a positive team culture through active participation in events and initiatives


Capabilities \& Qualifications

* Ability to write original copy for campaigns that is on strategy and consistent with brand voice
* Comfortable discussing strategies and briefs to better understand creative objectives
* Demonstrate strong conceptual thinking across a broad range of tactical channels
* Curious, open\-minded, and committed to continuous learning and development
* Excellent communication, organizational, and collaboration skills
* Portfolio demonstrating strong copywriting, concepts and campaigns
* Degree in a related field
* 3\-5\+ years of copywriting experience in an in\-house or agency environment


This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in\-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days.
