At Altra, we are on a never\-ending journey to seek out opportunities to unlock potential in ourselves and others and to create a more diverse and inclusive running community. When we’re all working together as the best versions of ourselves, we can feel empowered both individually and as a community.


So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side\-by\-side with a team of people driven to discover more about ourselves and the world around us, Altra just may be the place for you.

  

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Altra Careers or www.altrarunning.com.

**FOOTWEAR DEVELOPER**

**What will you do?**


A day in the life of a Footwear Developer at Altra looks a little like this.


The Footwear Developer will be responsible for driving the development, engineering, fit, margin adherence and specifications for new and existing Footwear from Final Design Review to Commercialization with a focus on Project based management. Drive footwear product development from seasonal kickoff to confirmation for production.


You will be responsible for collaborating with and supporting overall footwear cross\-functional teams to create best in class performance footwear. You will do this by focusing on footwear best practices/standards, fit and comfort, providing technical solutions, building product at cost and ensuring product quality.


Let’s break down that day\-in\-the\-life a bit more.

* Manage the development of products from kickoff to production ensuring triad adherence to the product creation calendar milestones through pro\-active follow ups.
* Initiate and lead meetings with product teams during various phases of development to review, evaluate, update and ultimately drive the decision\-making process that leads to on time Buy Ready and achieves margin goals.
* Confirm final development samples on time and ensure samples meet expected quality and accuracy standards. Manage retention and storage of samples in coordination with the Commercialization Manager.
* Work with VF Asia Development and factory Costing, Development, Engineering and Manufacturing teams to identify and leverage potential manufacturing efficiencies to drive reduced product cost.
* Evaluation and review of tooling including but not limited to reading 2D blueprints, reviewing 3D CADs and printing 3D components for physical review prior to approval to opening sample molds.
* Collaborate with VFA Asia development and the Materials Developer to recommend materials and provide technical expertise on constructions that meet Design intent without risking product integrity/quality, while meeting or exceeding gross margin targets.
* Provide the Commercialization Manager and Senior Product Developer product information needed to execute the wear testing of their projects from early prototypes to final confirmed sample testing.
* Collaborates with design team on the creation of technical packages (CADs, Shell Patterns, Tooling Artwork, Product Details, etc) which are used to build BOMs/specifications in Flex PLM.
* Publish the complete tech pack to factories and VFA development and maintain all records, files and samples associated with the products development.
* Ensure execution of fit through clear analysis, documentation, communication, adherence to fit standards, and partnering with the US Commercialization Manager, VF Asia Development and Commercialization teams.
* Address quality issues as they arise and collaborate with the US product team, VF Asia Product Supply, Quality Assurance, Marketing, Planning and Sales to ensure the accuracy and integrity of all product performance claims.
* Perform these and other duties as assigned.
* Attend VF Asia collaborative meetings with Development, Global Material Sourcing and Global Product Costing.

 **What do you need to succeed?**


We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 4\+ years of experience and professional achievements.


The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

* Self\-driven and able to independently manage products through the Development cycle
* Detail oriented with strong project management, organizational, work ethic and teamwork skills
* Strong problem solving and decision\-making skills
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Demonstrates a complete understanding of the development process from brief hand\-off to production
* Demonstrates a complete understanding of tooling processes including 2D/3D CAD and CAM processes
* Demonstrates a complete understanding of materials, pattern engineering, tooling processes and mold construction
* Demonstrates a complete understanding of product categories, materials, and product development cycle
* Contributes to and leads special/long\-term projects as they arise
* Competent in Adobe Illustrator, Product Management/Development systems and Microsoft Office program suite
* Overseas and domestic travel will be required on a seasonal basis. Irregular working hours should be expected during peak periods when deadlines are present

 **Now WE have a question for YOU.**

**Are you in?**


\#LI\-DD1

**Hiring Range****:**


$86,400\.00 USD \- $108,000\.00 USD annually**Incentive Potential**: This position is eligible for additional compensation awards that may include an annual incentive plan, sales incentive, or commission potential. Specific details of the additional compensation eligibility for this position will be provided during the recruiting and interview process.

**Benefits at VF Corporation**: You can review a general overview of each benefit program offered, including this year's medical plan rates on www.MyVFbenefits.com and by clicking **Looking to Join VF?** Detailed information on your benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

***P******lease note, our hiring ranges are determined and built from market pay data. In determining the specific compensation for this position, we comply with all local, state, and federal laws.***

All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to an individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. If you require accommodations during the application process, please contact us at* *peopleservices@vfc.com**. VF will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals to the extent required by applicable law.*

* Monitor kitchen performance and implement improvements to enhance efficiency.

* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, handling multiple tasks and maintaining attention to detail.

PATH is seeking candidates with experience in culinary services and current managerial food handler's certificates to join our Orange County Team as the Head Chef for our Yale Navigation Center.


**ABOUT OUR CULINARY SERVICES**  

Our Culinary Services Team is a critical to the success of our interim housing sites. By providing three meals and snacks and refreshments throughout the day, the kitchen and its staff are a key component to creating a welcoming, home\-like environment for our guests as they work to obtain and sustain permanent housing.


**WHAT IS A HEAD CHEF?**  

As part of the Interim Housing team, the Head Chef is responsible for providing administrative, supervisory, and quality control oversight to the kitchen staff and coordination of guests' dietary menu plans as needed.



Responsibilities include:


* **Staff Supervision \& Support**
	+ Provide direct supervision to all culinary staff, including Kitchen Associates, Lead Cooks, and Sous Chefs. Coordinate scheduling of all kitchen staff, including volunteers.
	+ Plan, set, and adjust as needed ongoing workload assignments and schedules for work completion. Ensure adherence to work and time schedules.
	+ Provide all necessary supports to volunteers to ensure they have a valuable experience.
* **Leadership \& Client Services**
	+ Promoting and following the established interim housing values, guidelines, and rules.
	+ Modeling and promoting a team culture and environment that is professional and welcoming for all interim housing guests, staff, volunteers, and other visitors
	+ Meeting with guests with medical dietary restrictions to set up menu plans
* **Kitchen Administration \& Oversight**
	+ Helping create and post monthly menus
	+ Assisting with the monitoring kitchen costs including labor, food, supplies, and equipment
	+ Helping to ensure inventories are maintained
	+ Reviewing Health Department reports along with Head Chef and Sous Chef and assisting with correcting violations
	+ Coordinating and maintaining relationships with kitchen vendors and donors
	+ Coordinating food donations, including assisting with pick\-ups and drop\-offs as necessary

description:
**Our "shefs" earn up to $5,000\+/wk working part time selling their food to our weekly subscribers!**

**Apply directly on our website at**: https://o.shef.com/apply\-in

**Job Details**

Escape the restaurant grind, shorten your commute, and set your own hours, all while cooking food you’re passionate about on Shef.

**Overview**

Shef is a weekly meal delivery service where all the food is cooked by local independent chefs. Our weekly subscribers order directly from these chefs to stock their fridge with meals for the week.

Whether you are looking for a part time hustle or full time gig, we've got you covered. Most orders occur within just 2\-3 days/wk. We take care of pretty much everything \- you just do the cooking!

**Job Description**

We are seeking talented chefs to cook for our weekly meal delivery service. It’s a flexible, unique opportunity to do (and cook) what you love, on your schedule.

We provide the customers, order management system, customer service, payment processing, long\-range delivery, and more. You just do the cooking!

All our chefs undergo vetting, taste tasting, and menu workshopping to ensure the food offerings meet our standards. Compensation is a flat fee per serving sold. Small volume chefs can earn up to \~$1k/week and large volume chefs can earn up to \~$5k\+/week

**You have:**

* Private chef, restaurant, catering, or professional kitchen experience
* Culinary School degree and/or 3\+ years of experience in restaurant kitchens
* Your food handler's or food manager's certificate (or are willing to obtain one)
* The ability (and space) to cook at least 20 servings a day
* Experience costing and sourcing ingredients

**You are:**

* Interested in doing your own thing, either on the side or more full time
* Able to cook 1\-4 days/week
* Motivated, responsive and professional
* Precise with food safety measures \& cleanliness

**How do I apply?**

**You MUSTapply directly on our website at**: https://o.shef.com/apply\-in

You will ONLY be considered once you apply on our site at the link above!

Whether you’re just getting started in your culinary journey, or are well\-established, Shef can help you grow with purpose and support. We have everything from culinary grads to Michelin\-trained chefs on our platform. We can't wait to hear from you!

Job Type: Contract

Pay: $500\.00 \- $5,000\.00 per week

* Fantastic communication skills and exudes empathy

**Now Hiring: Personal Trainer / Coach – Pinnacle Fitness, Scottsdale AZ** **Move Better. Feel Stronger. Live Pain\-Free.**

Pinnacle Fitness isn't just another gym. We're a results\-driven, family\-style fitness studio that specializes in working with adults aged 50 and over—and we just expanded! With an additional 2,100 square feet of space, we're looking for a passionate personal trainer/coach to help us serve our growing community.

We don't chase trends. We focus on what works: science\-backed strength training, mobility, and injury prevention tailored to the unique needs of our members. Our clients are looking to get out of pain, regain confidence in their bodies, and turn the clock back on their health—and we help them do exactly that.

**Who You Are:**

* You know the human body inside and out—especially when it comes to joint health, injury history, and post\-rehab care.
* You might have worked as a PT tech, or have experience working with older adults and those dealing with chronic aches and pains.
* You thrive in a team environment, where collaboration, education, and continual learning are part of the culture.
* You're an enthusiastic coach who cares deeply about client success and delivers a five\-star experience every session.

**What We Offer:**

* A supportive, team\-oriented culture where coaches learn, grow, and improve together.
* Paid continuing education – we invest in your growth through workshops and seminars.
* A truly unique, non\-intimidating training environment where your creativity and coaching skills can shine.
* Opportunity to train 1\-on\-1, semi\-private, and group fitness classes with our growing client base.
* **You will never be asked to sell, cold call, or market yourself.** We handle all client acquisition — you just show up and coach.

**The Role:**

**Part \-Time with Full \-Time potential.**

**Core Schedule (Required):** Monday–Thursday, 12:00 PM–7:00 PM One Saturday/month, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM

**Optional Add\-On (Preferred but not required):** Friday, 7:00 AM–2:00 PM — We'd love someone who can take Fridays, but the right Monday–Thursday candidate won't be passed over if Fridays don't work.

* $23–$25/hour, paid for all working hours (including programming and follow\-up)
* Design and deliver personalized training sessions
* Coach small groups and lead classes
* Follow up with clients and adjust plans based on progress
* Collaborate with our coaching team to bring innovative ideas and energy to the floor

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Exercise Science or related field OR current certification (NASM, NSCA, ISSA, ACE, ACSM, etc.)
* Strong understanding of anatomy and kinesiology
* Proven ability to work with special populations, particularly those aged 50\+
* Great communicator and motivator
* Self\-starter, coachable, friendly, and reliable

At Pinnacle Fitness, our mission is simple: *"We help people move better, so they can move more."*

If you're ready to change lives—including your own—we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $23\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Ability to Commute:

* Scottsdale, AZ 85255 (Required)

Work Location: In person

We are looking for a Hair Stylist to create flawless haircuts and hairstyles for our customers. Hair Stylist responsibilities include cutting hair using basic and advanced techniques, consulting customers about styles and colors and applying hair care products, like treatment oils and masks. If you have experience cutting short and long hair and are up\-to\-date with styling trends, we’d like to meet you. Ultimately, you will ensure all customers leave our salon satisfied with our services and feel happy with their new looks. It is necessary for this position to be working some Sundays.

**Responsibilities**

* Welcome customers and identify their preferences by asking pointed questions
* Recommend hairstyles and haircuts according to customers’ face shapes and tastes
* Wash, rinse and dry clients’ hair using appropriate shampoos and conditioners (e.g. for oily hair or dry scalp)
* Cut, trim and shave hair using professional equipment
* Apply a wide range of hair coloring techniques, like highlights, ombre and balayage
* Create hairstyles for formal events and everyday looks, including braids, ponytails and buns
* Apply hair treatment products, as needed (e.g. color protection creams and hydrating masks)
* Form bonds with loyal customers and remember their hairstyle preferences
* Manage bookings and serve walk\-ins
* Ensure tidiness of beauty stations and sterilize tools, as needed
* Cross\-sell hair care products or services, when appropriate

**Skills**

* Work experience as a Hair Stylist, Hairdresser, Colorist or similar role
* Proficiency in hair straightening and curling methods, using hot irons and curlers
* Hands\-on experience with various coloring techniques
* Knowledge of a wide range of haircuts, suitable for all hair lengths (e.g. braids and top knots)
* Familiarity with hair treatment products and services, like keratin smoothing
* Up\-to\-date with industry trends
* Excellent communication skills
* Physical stamina to stand for long hours
* Flexibility to work in shifts
* Valid license from a cosmetology school

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: $600\.00 \- $2,500\.00 per week

Work Location: In person

The Real Estate Construction Director role has a national salary range of $104,000\- $198,000\.


DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, General Bonus Plan and a generous PTO policy. ?

  

Would you like to join the Logistics Company for the World? Have you often wondered how products get from point A to point B? DHL Supply Chain does just that.


Become an essential part of everyday life, by contributing to an organization that is Connecting People and Improving Lives. If you have a passion for people, a desire to problem\-solve, and eagerness to pursue continuous improvement opportunities... we look forward to exploring career possibilities with you!

 **Job Description**


This position shall be responsible for management and oversight of DPDHL construction projects including renovations/improvements to existing and acquired facilities with emphasis on tenant improvement projects associated with warehouse/distribution facilities and/or PUDs/Ground Hubs. This position shall function as the primary liaison between Operations and Real Estate and will be responsible for translating operational needs into construction requirements. This individual will partner with Operations resources and engage directly with Business colleagues to define requirements and manage customer expectations.

  

* The Construction Director role requires a person with a technical background either in construction, facility management and/or industrial/civil engineering.
* The person must be familiar with warehouse/distribution construction and design.
* Develop relationships with preferred landowners, developers, partners and external consultants.
* Responsibilities will include: facility evaluation and assessment, review of building requirements for operational needs, project scoping/development of construction specifications, cost estimating, and construction oversight.
* Travel throughout the US/Canada and multi project organizational skills are also required for this position. A valid trade certificate, post education in a construction related field or five plus years of facility management and/or construction experience are preferred.

 **Required Education and Experience**


Candidate should possess one or more of the following requirements:

* Bachelors Degree (i.e. \- Construction Management or relevant degree), required
* Warehouse/Industrial Construction/Facility Management Experience
* 7\+ years of experience
* Must be able to travel 30\-40%
* Strong Technical/Engineering/Operations Background
* Financial Background preferred
* Project Management Experience/Training

  



Our Organization has a business casual environment and focuses on teamwork, associate development, training, and continuous improvement. We offer competitive wages, excellent affordable insurance benefits (including health, dental, vision and life), 401K plan, paid vacation and holidays.


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

VIC the PICC ("VTP") is a specialized healthcare provider focused on vascular access consulting services to acute care hospitals, skilled nursing facilities and home healthcare. We provide vascular access device insertion services, post access support services including declotting, line removal, port access and venous access troubleshooting. VTP also provides continuing education, precepting and other educational support to clinical team members and customers.



VTP provides on\-site and mobile vascular access support services throughout the Western and Southern United States and prides itself on delivering innovative, affordable and easy to procure services with high levels of client and patient satisfaction.



VTP strives to create an uplifting career opportunity for clinical team members and an environment that emphasizes our core values of Integrity, Support, Respect, Inquisitiveness, Compassion and Stewardship.

**Job Description**



As a Vascular Access Nurse Consultant, you will work collaboratively with our customer's clinical team to resolve venous access issues to facilitate the treatment objectives of the treating physician. You may work inside or outside the hospital setting depending on each individual referral, providing you with a unique career opportunity to observe different treatment protocols and patient challenges. If you are looking for a change and tired of 12 hours on your feet or rushing from patient to patient with no time to provide quality care, this would be the perfect opportunity for you.



As a VTP Vascular Access Nurse Consultant you will:


* Place PICCs, midlines, and peripheral IVs using ultrasound guidance
* Utilize ECG technology for PICC tip confirmation
* Assist with management of PICCs and Vascular Access devices.
* Provide a wide range of vascular access support services including but not limited to port access, removal of lines, declotting, etc.
* Educate facility nursing staff regarding PICCs, midlines and many other CVAD's


**Scheduling**



In this role, Consultants visit patients in different customer facilities and therefore must be willing to travel to customer facilities and able to fulfill scheduling requirements as indicated based on business needs. Full\-time scheduling requirements include three to four days per week, including weekends, and participation in the holiday rotation. Part\-time (Per Diem) scheduling requirements include a minimum of 4 scheduled shifts per month, including weekends, and participation in the holiday rotation.


**Training and Experience Requirements**


* Ideal candidates are experienced in both ultrasound guided IV (USGIV) placements and vascular access device (VAD) insertions.
* Training available in some locations for candidates with recent, consistent USGIV placement experience.
* Priority given to fully trained vascular access nurses, but additional training available for those with strong USGIV skills.


**Required Qualifications**


* Registered Nurse with current license
* American Heart BLS Certification
* Experience in **vascular access device (VAD) management**, including care, maintenance, and troubleshooting
* Experience placing **ultrasound\-guided IVs (USGIVs)**
* Ability to work independently and fulfill scheduling requirements as indicated by job classification
* Valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and reliable transportation for travel to patient sites
* Must possess a smart phone
* Must LOVE vascular access!


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Minimum of 3 years of acute care RN experience
* Experience placing PICCs, midlines, or other vascular access devices using ultrasound
* Prior vascular access or PICC experience preferred

 **Why Join VTP?**  

We offer benefits that truly enhance work\-life balance and job satisfaction:


* **Competitive pay** with performance\-based bonuses.
* **Professional Development**: Ongoing education, training, and mentorship.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** for full\-time employees, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and paid time off.
* **Company provided vehicle or mileage reimbursement** for travel between patient sites.
* **Supportive Culture**: Join a positive, growth\-focused team with 24/7 on\-call support.


We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. If you're passionate about vascular access and ready to grow with us, apply today!

Serve as a clinical expert in a specific area of nursing practice, providing guidance and support to nursing staff.

Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to identify areas for improvement and implement best practices.  

Ensure adherence to hospital policies, state and federal regulations, and accreditation standards.  

Provide guidance on compliance issues and assist in regulatory audits and inspections.  

Advocate for the highest quality of care for patients and families.  

Address patient and family concerns and assist in resolving any issues related to care.  

Stay updated on the latest research and advancements in nursing practice.  

Assist in the implementation of evidence\-based practices to improve patient outcomes.  

Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of education sessions, quality improvement initiatives, and compliance efforts.  

Generate reports and data analysis to track progress and outcomes.

 **What you will need:**


Bachelors Degree Nursing Required Or  

Masters Degree Nursing Preferred  

5\+ Years of clinical nursing experience required \- current inpatient medical /surgical, critical care strongly preferred  

Registered Nurse (RN) \- Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) Current Illinois Registered Nurse (RN) license. Required  

BLS (AHA ) and ACLS required

Most companies claim to have the best people. We say to them, "Keep dreaming." Our people are second to none. They set us apart with their entrepreneurial spirit and ambition. They come to us from the likes of Amazon, Microsoft, Nordstrom, Starbucks and the sports world, bringing energy, bold ideas and a willingness to dive into the unfamiliar. It's our people that make BDA the top global Merchandise Agency to work for.

**Location:**This position follows a hybrid schedule, with team members working onsite four days per week from any of our BDA offices in Indianapolis, IN; Troy, MI; Woodinville, WA; Austin, TX; or Atlanta, GA.


**Position Summary**



In this role, you are both strategic and sales\-driven to manage and grow a portfolio of high\-value enterprise and hybrid accounts within the branded merchandise industry. This role requires a deep understanding of the promotional products space, strong enterprise\-level relationship management, and a proven ability to drive revenue growth through strategic planning, value\-driven selling, and cross\-functional collaboration.



You must be both a strategist and a closer and thrive on expanding client relationships, exceeding sales goals, and delivering creative solutions that align with brand compliance and client marketing objectives.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Sales \& Account Growth**


* Prepare and maintain an actionable strategic account plan using the OST model (Objective, Strategy, Tactics) for all assigned accounts focused on quarterly budget attainment (profit and margin results).
* Own and exceed sales and margin goals across assigned accounts.
* Identify new opportunities within existing accounts to drive incremental revenue through strategic prospecting and relationship building.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, aligning merchandise strategies with their broader marketing and brand objectives.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Account Business Reviews (ABRs), delivering insights, performance metrics, and strategic roadmaps.
* Forecast revenue and contribute to long\-term strategic planning for key accounts.
* Ensure data hygiene guideline compliance. Manage all opportunities, tasks, and key performance indicators to prescribed guidelines through insights from Salesforce CRM, promo and program performance analysis, and proactive recommendations.


**Client Relationship \& Brand Stewardship**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, serving as the primary point of contact.
* Ensure full compliance with brand guidelines, contracts, and program standards.
* Deliver proactive, solutions\-oriented support to meet evolving client needs, acting as both consultant and problem\-solver.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with Creative, Merchandising, Programs, Sales Ops, Supplier Relations, and other internal teams to deliver a best\-in\-class client experience.
* Develop merchandise strategies that reflect market trends and elevate the client's brand.
* Coordinate and manage multiple complex projects with varying scopes, timelines, and logistical considerations.


**Operational Execution**

* Ensure client pre\-sale, order and approval processes, supplier compliance standards and production timeline expectations are met
* Ensure all project communications, updates, and deliverables meet client and internal expectations.
* Accurately log and manage account activity in Salesforce to ensure full pipeline visibility and performance tracking.


**Client Events \& Onboarding**


* Successfully onboard new enterprise clients, ensuring a smooth and strategic launch.
* Coordinate and attend client events as needed, ensuring high satisfaction and brand alignment.
* Participation in departmental and other meetings as required
* Other duties as assigned by direct manager, sales leadership and/or executive team


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in the branded merchandise/promotional products industry preferred.
* Proven track record of sales success and strategic account growth.
* Exceptional communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and ability to navigate sensitive client interactions.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
* High level of curiosity, accountability, and a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time.


*\#LI\-CH1*  

*\#LI\-Hybrid*


*We are pleased to share the base salary range for this position is $82,000 to $92,000 in WA with bonus opportunities; $70,000 to $82,000 in IN, MI, TX and GA with bonus opportunities. If you are hired at BDA, your compensation will be determined based on factors that may include geographic location, skills, education, and experience. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any offer. In the spirit of pay transparency, the range listed is the full base salary range for the role and hiring at the top of the range would not be typical, in order to allow for future salary growth. The range listed is just one component of BDA's total compensation and rewards programs, which includes: robust PTO; vacation, a paid volunteer day, holidays and summer Fridays, Benefits; medical, dental, vision, life, and AD\&D insurance, 401k; tuition reimbursement, mental health and financial wellness programs and professional development opportunities including tuition reimbursement. Certain revenue\-generating positions may be eligible for incentive compensation.*


BDA is more than a workplace \- it's a family. For more than four decades we've promoted a vibrant and welcoming culture that not only accepts but demands you to be different. The quirky, the bold, the creative and the unique make up the foundation of a company that the most iconic brands in the world look to help tell their story through the power of merchandise.

BDA Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

**Title:** Event Services Manager – Hampton and Homewood Suites by Hilton San Juan

**Reports To:** Director of Sales and Marketing

**Employer:** \[PG Hospitality Operator, LLC], an affiliate of PRISA Group (the “Company”)

**Location:** San Juan, Puerto Rico

**Job Overview**

PRISA Hospitality is seeking an organized, service\-driven, and detail\-oriented hospitality professional to support the opening and ongoing operations of the dual\-branded Hampton by Hilton San Juan and Homewood Suites by Hilton San Juan.

The Event Services Manager serves as the primary contact for all contracted groups, meetings, and catering events following the sales process. This position is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing every operational aspect of group and event business to ensure exceptional client satisfaction and flawless event execution.

Working closely with the Group Sales \& Events Manager, Director of Sales \& Marketing, Operations, Food \& Beverage, Front Office, Housekeeping, and Engineering, the Event Services Manager develops Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), Group Resumes, rooming lists, and detailed event specifications while ensuring seamless communication across all hotel departments.

As a key member of the hotel's opening team, this position plays an essential role in delivering memorable guest experiences, strengthening client relationships, and generating repeat business through exceptional service and operational excellence.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Event Planning \& Coordination**

* Serve as the primary hotel contact for clients after contracts have been executed.
* Coordinate all operational details for corporate meetings, association groups, social events, and local catering functions.
* Conduct planning meetings with clients to confirm event requirements, schedules, room setups, audiovisual needs, catering functions, and special requests.
* Develop accurate Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), Group Resumes, rooming lists, and event documentation.
* Ensure all client expectations and operational requirements are communicated clearly to hotel departments.

**Event Execution**

* Coordinate and oversee event execution to ensure all contracted services are delivered according to client expectations and Hilton standards.
* Act as the primary on\-site contact during meetings, conferences, banquets, and catering events.
* Monitor event flow and proactively resolve operational issues to ensure a seamless guest experience.
* Coordinate last\-minute changes while maintaining operational efficiency and guest satisfaction.
* Conduct post\-event follow\-up with clients to ensure satisfaction and identify future business opportunities.

**Interdepartmental Coordination**

* Ensure all departments understand their responsibilities for upcoming events.
* Coordinate room block management, VIP arrivals, meeting room readiness, banquet setups, and special accommodations.
* Partner closely with the Food \& Beverage Manager to ensure banquet menus, service timing, staffing, and event execution exceed guest expectations.

**Guest Experience**

* Deliver exceptional customer service throughout the planning and execution process.
* Build strong relationships with meeting planners, event organizers, corporate clients, and group leaders.
* Anticipate client needs and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the guest experience.
* Resolve guest concerns professionally while maintaining positive client relationships and protecting hotel interests.

**Revenue Enhancement**

* Identify opportunities for menu enhancements, upgrades, and other revenue\-generating opportunities.
* Support efforts to maximize banquet revenue and overall event profitability.
* Encourage repeat business through exceptional service and relationship management.

**Sales \& Administrative Support**

* Maintain accurate client records, event documentation, and booking details within Delphi and Hilton sales systems.
* Ensure Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), Group Resumes, rooming lists, and operational documents are completed accurately and distributed on time.
* Participate in site inspections, client presentations, and sales meetings as needed.
* Assist with forecasting, reporting, and event pipeline management.

**Pre\-Opening Responsibilities**

* Establish BEO templates, Group Resume formats, event checklists, and communication procedures.
* Participate in operational readiness activities, mock events, and opening training.
* Collaborate with hotel leadership to establish service standards for meetings and events.
* Support the successful opening of banquet, meeting, and catering operations.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with PRISA leadership and hotel department leaders to support company objectives and strategic initiatives.
* Champion continuous improvement of event planning, communication, and guest satisfaction processes.
* Perform other duties and special projects assigned by the Director of Sales \& Marketing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of three (3\) years of progressive experience in hotel event planning, catering, conference services, or group operations within a branded hotel environment.
* Experience with Delphi and Hilton sales systems preferred.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail.
* Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on business demands and event schedules.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Passion for creating exceptional guest and client experiences.
* Outstanding organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building abilities.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously.
* Calm, professional, and solution\-oriented under pressure.
* Ability to coordinate multiple departments while maintaining operational excellence.
* Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, accountability, and commitment to Hilton brand standards.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced pre\-opening environment while maintaining flexibility and exceptional service.

**Why Join Us**

At PRISA Hospitality, we believe in developing talent from within. We offer opportunities for growth, exposure to world\-class hospitality brands, and the chance to be part of transformative projects in Puerto Rico's tourism and entertainment industry. We offer a dynamic and collaborative work environment, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to grow within a respected Puerto Rico\-based organization with global brand partnerships.

We invite qualified hospitality professionals to submit their resume and cover letter to join this exciting new project.

**We are an equal employment opportunity employer.**

Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $42,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

* Additional terms and conditions apply to the Sign\-on Bonus, which terms and conditions will be provided upon hire and provided upon request during the application process.

***Qualifier: must have worked in a sales position in the timeshare industry within the last three years for a minimum of one year.***


Paid training: training pay $27\.50/hr.

**JOB SUMMARY**


Contribute to the success of the organization and sales distribution site by effectively using sales techniques and processes to convert prospective owners into purchasers as well as reload Owners. Develop relationships with prospective owners by soliciting and following up on referrals and leads. Cater the sales experience to the individual needs and preferences of each potential owner, and follow through with the sales contract process to ensure that all required paperwork and legally required documents are completed accurately and in a timely manner efficiently. Maintain the customer relationship after the sale is complete to ensure continued owner satisfaction with the organization and to develop future business opportunities (i.e., reloads, referrals, additional sales).

 **CANDIDATE PROFILE**


Education and Experience


Required:

* High school diploma or GED
* Proficiency in English
* Incumbent is required to maintain an active and in\-good standing professional Real Estate License where mandated by law

  

Preferred:

* One\-year related experience

  

Successful Candidates Will Be Willing To:

* Must be willing to work weekends and holidays as required by business needs

 **JOB SPECIFIC TASKS**

 **Building and Maintaining Customer Base**

* Answer owner questions regarding use of properties and location amenities; make recommendations given the background information obtained on the owner through discovery.
* Follow up on referrals/leads from owners.
* Fulfill requests from owners or prospects regarding pricing, property maps, property descriptions, room locations, and portfolio/network information.
* Contact owners to monitor satisfaction, make aware of upcoming promotions, and develop business opportunities (e.g., reloads, referrals).
* Develop and maintain records on customer contacts and use that information to support effective follow\-up opportunities.
* Monitor contract processing to minimize rescission decisions, provide comprehensive owner assurance and ensure timeliness of closings.

 **Giving Sales Presentations**

* Follow and adhere to the Consultative Sales Process when presenting to owners and guests.
* Establish trust with the prospective owner and Owners throughout the entire sales process to build on\-going rapport.
* Discover the needs of prospective owners and Owners through a series of strategically layered questions/discussion and utilize the information to customize the sales presentation.
* Provide prospective owners and Owners a Sales Gallery, Property and Model tour specific to their sales distribution site.
* Explain the features, advantages and benefits of the product and advocate the appropriate amount of points to accommodate the prospective owners and Owners current and future vacation needs.
* Complete and close the sales contract process by ensuring all required/legal paperwork and documents are signed and notarized.
* Practice and continue to develop and improve sales script and presentation.
* Ensure clear understanding of finance options and present as an approach to ownership.
* Prepare for daily appointments (e.g., review tour sheet, owner history, presentation details, etc).
* Follow up face\-to\-face guest interaction with email, phone, or mail correspondence and facilitates use of Vacation Ownership Advisor.
* Answer Owner and customer questions regarding product information, servicing issues, construction work, financing, maintenance, repairs, and appraisals.
* Use, demonstrate, and/or coordinate virtual tour (eTour) software for guests.

 **Conducting and Managing Business Transactions**

* Assure complete and accurate processing of documents pertaining to sales.
* Review details of contracts with prospective owners and Owners once they decide on purchase.
* Thoroughly review loan applications and financial documents with the customer and ensure completed properly.
* Work with Sales Management to minimize cancellations, provide comprehensive owner assurance and ensure timeliness of closings.
* Analyze problems and formulate a strategy and plan to overcome challenges of getting work done quickly with a high degree of quality.
* Complete purchase summary worksheet at end of each sale.
* Reach out to and influence Legacy Owners and Every Other Year (EOY) Owners to enroll, upgrade and maximize all reload opportunities.

 **Providing Service to Others**

* Respond to and monitor the resolution of customer and Owner inquiries in a timely manner with accurate information.
* Leverage resources for providing service to guests and Owners (e.g., Vacation Ownership Advisors) in an effective manner.

**Other**

* Manage time effectively to punctually attend daily team meetings, training sessions, and guest/owner appointments.
* Demonstrate total understanding of the culture and processes of the organization.
* Improve sales presentation approach through self\-critique, practice, and lessons from the feedback provided by others (e.g., Sales Manager Coaches, Guests, Owners).
* Participate in formal training sessions offered by management team.
* Attend daily huddles and regularly scheduled team/manager meetings.
* Assist in the development and mentoring of other Sales/Membership Executives as requested.
* Maintain an awareness of current events (e.g., news, sports, pop\-culture) and information on site locations to enable and promote customer relationship building.

description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. **Job Summary**


Establish commonality and build rapport with prospective and/or current owners. Articulate the benefits of traveling with Wyndham Destinations. Demonstrate a positive attitude within a high\-energy environment.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**


Conduct face\-to\-face presentations in our state\-of\-the\-art sales centers located at one of our award\-winning resorts. Find commonality with prospective and/or current owners. Communicate the benefits of traveling with Wyndham Destinations. Generate sales through initializing transactions and utilizing proper closing techniques. Leads are prequalified and provided by the company. Attend ongoing, advanced sales and career training.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Effectively present and deliver sales presentation in accordance with all company policies, compliance standards and regulatory requirements while maintaining minimum performance goals (80% time)
* Attend all scheduled training sessions, department meetings, keep current on sales information and materials, keep current on industry trends, and set and review performance goals weekly, monthly and annually. (20%)

**Travel Requirements**


No travel required outside of the home site’s area.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**


1 to 3 years of sales and/or marketing experience is preferred, not required. Must maintain production standards. Must have the applicable real estate and/or timeshare license or the ability to obtain one.

**Education**

* High School Diploma or equivalent is required.

**Training requirements**

* Initial Paid Training, covering our sales process, product knowledge, and the psychology of the sale.

**Knowledge and skills**

* Needs to be able to overcome objections and perform within a short, luxury sales cycle. Must be energetic, outgoing and tenacious.

**Technical Skills**

* General smart device skills.

**Job experience**

* 1 to 3 years of sales and/or marketing experience is preferred, not required.

*Experience equivalent to the education requirement may be accepted in lieu of the education requirement.*

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

This role will be instrumental in scaling the impact of Himalaya's growth marketing function as our paid and social commerce channels grow. This role will report to the Director of Growth Marketing.

As a Digital Designer, you will be responsible for producing visual and light video assets across Himalaya's Amazon presence, social channels, and paid media. Your objective will be to give Himalaya's growth marketing function the creative volume it needs to scale — operating as the team's AI\-forward creative resource across every asset you produce.

This position is responsible for expanding Himalaya's creative capacity across Amazon, social, and paid digital channels.


**Amazon Digital Shelf Design**


* Design Amazon A\+ Content, Brand Store modules, and PDP visual assets across a multi\-SKU catalog.
* Partner with the Ecommerce and Brand teams to keep content current, on\-brand, and compliant with product claims.


**Social \& Paid Creative**


* Create paid social ad creative — static and light video — for testing and scaling what performs.
* Assist in producing organic social content and brand assets in partnership with the Social Lead.

Adapt creative across formats and platforms as paid and social commerce channels scale.  
* 

**Content Production \& Volume**


* Keep every asset on\-brand and production\-ready, with no additional handoffs required to ship.

Manage a high volume of concurrent design requests across paid, social, and ecommerce stakeholders.  
* 

**Champions AI**


Own the exploration and application of AI creative tools — image generation, video, and asset variation — across content production. Stay at the forefront of emerging AI capabilities and translate them into scalable production practices across Amazon, social, and paid channels.  

* 

**Qualifications**


* 2–4 years of experience in graphic/digital design, ideally at a CPG, DTC, beauty, or wellness brand.

* High use and familiarity of AI creative tools (e.g., Midjourney, Firefly, Nano Banana, or equivalent).
* Experience designing for Amazon (A\+ Content, Brand Store, PDP) and paid/organic social.
* A portfolio demonstrating range across ecommerce, social, and paid channels.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to take direction from multiple stakeholders across paid, social, and ecommerce.
* Comfort with ambiguity, a high volume of concurrent requests, and a willingness to keep learning new tools.
* Experience with video editing and project management tools.
* Experience and a personal interest in supplements, the natural products industry, or personal care is a significant advantage to candidates.

**Compensation and Benefits**


* Competitive base salary and bonus, commensurate with experience (target $65\-$75k)
* Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability \& 401(k)

Camilla Langston, HR Manager, Camilla.Langston@himalayausa.com, 713\-234\-3201

**Position Summary**

The Great Falls Symphony Association is seeking a creative, detail\-oriented, and highly organized Marketing \& Graphic Design Coordinator to support the organization’s marketing, communications, social media, email marketing, and graphic design needs. This position will work under the direction of the Marketing \& Development Director. The Marketing \& Graphic Design Coordinator will be responsible for executing much of the day\-to\-day design and content production work, including print and digital advertising, social media content, eblasts, program books, brochures, fundraising materials, and other marketing materials.

The ideal candidate will have strong graphic design skills, excellent attention to detail, proficiency in professional design software, and the ability to create polished materials that reflect the Great Falls Symphony’s brand, mission, and artistic excellence.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Graphic Design** 

Design and produce high\-quality print and digital materials including but not limited to:

* Season brochure, renewal materials, envelopes, and order forms
* Annual program books and concert programs
* Black Tie \& Blue Jeans gala materials, including invitations, programs, table numbers, posters, bid cards, signage, and related event material
* Fund Drive materials, newsletters, donor remittance materials, and thank\-you cards
* Tickets, ticket envelopes, signage, flyers, postcards, inserts, and other printed pieces
* Print and digital advertisements for concerts, fundraising campaigns, education programs, and special events
* Templates and branded assets for recurring marketing needs

**Email Marketing \& Digital Communications**

Create email marketing campaigns, including:

* Designing and formatting eblasts for concerts, events, fundraising campaigns, donor communications, and special announcements
* Creating written and visual content for email campaigns
* Coordinating content, images, links, and calls to action

**Social Media Content**

Develop and prepare social media content for the Great Falls Symphony’s platforms, including:

* Designing graphics, posts, stories, banners, and promotional content
* Creating content for Symphony concerts, Chamber Music Series, Youth Orchestra, Youth Matinee, Free Family Concert, fundraising campaigns, Black Tie \& Blue Jeans, and all other organizational activities
* Repurposing approved marketing copy and campaign themes for social media use
* Assisting with social media calendars and scheduled posts

**Website Support**

Provide website support as assigned which may include:

* Updating event graphics, images, copy, or links as directed
* Preparing web\-ready graphics and assets
* Assisting with basic page updates for concerts, events, campaigns, and announcements
* Ensuring visual consistency between website materials and other marketing collateral

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated graphic design experience, preferably with both print and digital materials
* Proficiency in professional design software such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, Canva, or comparable platforms
* Ability to design multi\-page publications, including program books, brochures, or similar materials
* Experience creating content for social media, email marketing, print advertising, and digital campaigns
* Strong visual judgment and understanding of layout, typography, branding, and file preparation
* Excellent attention to detail, especially with dates, names, sponsor listings, concert information, and donor recognition
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once
* Strong written communication skills
* Ability to work independently while taking direction and feedback well
* Reliable access to a computer, internet, and necessary design software
* Must be eligible to work in the United States
* Must pass a background check

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with nonprofit organizations, arts organizations, orchestras, performing arts groups, or event\-based marketing
* Familiarity with email marketing platforms, social media scheduling tools, website content management systems, and basic web design principles
* Photography, video editing, or basic motion graphics experience
* Appreciation for classical music, live performance, community arts, or nonprofit mission\-driven work

**Portfolio Requirement**

Applicants must submit a **PDF portfolio or PDF work sample** with their application.

The portfolio should demonstrate the applicant’s ability to create polished, professional marketing and design materials. Samples may include, but are not limited to:

* Program books or multi\-page publications
* Brochures, annual reports, or event programs
* Social media graphics
* Email marketing examples
* Print or digital advertisements
* Fundraising or event material
* Website or digital campaign assets

**Work Schedule**

This is a part\-time position averaging approximately 20 hours per week. The schedule may vary depending on concert cycles, campaign deadlines, and special events.

This position may be hybrid, with some in\-office work preferred when possible. A fully remote arrangement may be considered for a highly qualified candidate who can communicate effectively, meet deadlines, and successfully collaborate with staff from a distance.

Some evening or weekend availability may be required for concerts, events, or urgent production deadlines.

**To Apply**

Please submit the following to hillaryrose@gfsymphony.org:

1\. Cover letter

2\. Resume

3\. PDF portfolio or PDF work sample

4\. Three professional references

Applications should demonstrate experience in graphic design, digital marketing, social media content creation, and production of polished print or digital materials.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Great Falls, MT 59401

description:
**About EAB**


At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data\-driven insights and best\-in\-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.



At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.



For more information, visit our careers page.

  


**The Role in Brief:**


***Product Experience Designer (PXD), Analyst***



The Product Experience Designer (PXD) is a creative, technically minded member of EAB's Product organization responsible for transforming product strategy into compelling interactive experiences. Working at the intersection of Product Management, User Experience, and Go\-to\-Market teams, this role creates high\-fidelity prototypes, product demonstrations, and future\-state concepts that bring EAB's technology vision to life.



As a core member of the Product organization, the Product Experience Designer participates in product planning, design reviews, roadmap discussions, and development ceremonies to ensure commercial experiences accurately reflect current capabilities while showcasing the future direction of our products. This individual rapidly prototypes new ideas, designs narrative\-driven demonstrations, and creates reusable experiences that help customers, partners, and internal teams understand the value of EAB's technology.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning new technologies, experimenting with AI\-assisted design and prototyping tools, and translating complex product concepts into intuitive, engaging experiences. Success requires strong visual design instincts, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Customer Success.



Reporting to Product Management and partnering closely with Product Design, this individual will leverage modern design and prototyping platforms—including Figma, AI\-assisted design tools, and emerging technologies—to accelerate product storytelling and strengthen EAB's commercial product experiences.



This position is ideally based in Richmond, VA or Washington, DC but is also open to remote employment within the continental United States.



This position is posted at both the Analyst and Senior Analyst levels; candidates are being considered across both levels based on experience, with final level determined at the time of offer.

  


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Design high\-fidelity interactive prototypes that communicate current product capabilities, future concepts, and strategic product vision.
* Create narrative\-driven product demonstrations that illustrate how EAB technology solves real\-world challenges for higher education institutions.
* Participate as an embedded member of the Product organization by attending product planning sessions, roadmap reviews, design critiques, sprint reviews, and other product ceremonies.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineering teams to ensure prototypes and demonstrations accurately represent product functionality and design direction.
* Translate product requirements, concepts, and early\-stage ideas into compelling visual experiences that support discovery, planning, validation, and commercialization.
* Build and maintain reusable prototype assets utilizing EAB's design system, component libraries, and modern prototyping platforms.
* Explore and adopt emerging AI\-powered design and prototyping tools that improve the speed and quality of product visualization.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Partner Success, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to create product experiences that support launches, customer conversations, conferences, executive briefings, and strategic initiatives.
* Develop future\-state concepts that help leadership, customers, and internal teams visualize long\-term product strategy before engineering development begins.
* Continuously improve EAB's library of commercial product experiences, ensuring demonstrations remain aligned with evolving product capabilities and roadmap priorities.
* Participate in stretch projects and strategic initiatives that advance Product and Go\-to\-Market collaboration.

  


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Product Design, User Experience, Human\-Computer Interaction, Information Architecture, Graphic Design, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–3\+ years of professional experience in UX design, product design, prototyping, product marketing, demonstration design, or related disciplines.
* Experience building interactive prototypes using Figma or comparable prototyping platforms.
* Strong visual design skills with exceptional attention to detail and an eye for polished user experiences.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, software platforms, and AI\-assisted design tools.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with experience working across cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* A portfolio demonstrating interactive prototypes, product experiences, UX work, or similar design projects.

  


**Ideal Qualifications:**


* Experience working with product management and agile software development teams.
* Familiarity with modern product design systems and component\-based design methodologies.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies to accelerate design and prototyping workflows.
* Experience creating executive presentations, customer demonstrations, product storytelling assets, or conference experiences.
* Familiarity with higher education technology or SaaS products.
* Understanding of design thinking, human\-centered design, and product development methodologies.
* Ability to balance creativity with technical accuracy when representing software products.
* Demonstrated curiosity, experimentation, and a passion for continuously improving design workflows and emerging technologies.
* Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB's mission, values, and aspirations.


*If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.*

  


**Compensation:**



The anticipated starting salary (base) range for this role is $58,000 \- $75,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.



This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

  


**Benefits:**



Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
* 20\+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
* Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
* Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre\-tax commuter plans
* Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
* Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
* Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
* Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non\-birthing parents
* Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
* Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
* Company\-provided life, AD\&D, and disability insurance
* Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
* Access to employee resource groups, merit\-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities


Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits.


*This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.*

description:
**About EAB**


At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data\-driven insights and best\-in\-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.



At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.



For more information, visit our careers page.

  


**The Role in Brief:**


***Product Experience Designer (PXD), Senior Analyst***



The Product Experience Designer (PXD) is a creative, technically minded member of EAB's Product organization responsible for transforming product strategy into compelling interactive experiences. Working at the intersection of Product Management, User Experience, and Go\-to\-Market teams, this role creates high\-fidelity prototypes, product demonstrations, and future\-state concepts that bring EAB's technology vision to life.



As a core member of the Product organization, the Product Experience Designer participates in product planning, design reviews, roadmap discussions, and development ceremonies to ensure commercial experiences accurately reflect current capabilities while showcasing the future direction of our products. This individual rapidly prototypes new ideas, designs narrative\-driven demonstrations, and creates reusable experiences that help customers, partners, and internal teams understand the value of EAB's technology.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning new technologies, experimenting with AI\-assisted design and prototyping tools, and translating complex product concepts into intuitive, engaging experiences. Success requires strong visual design instincts, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Customer Success.



Reporting to Product Management and partnering closely with Product Design, this individual will leverage modern design and prototyping platforms—including Figma, AI\-assisted design tools, and emerging technologies—to accelerate product storytelling and strengthen EAB's commercial product experiences.



This position is ideally based in Richmond, VA or Washington, DC but is also open to remote employment within the continental United States.



This position is posted at both the Analyst and Senior Analyst levels; candidates are being considered across both levels based on experience, with final level determined at the time of offer.

  


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Design high\-fidelity interactive prototypes that communicate current product capabilities, future concepts, and strategic product vision.
* Create narrative\-driven product demonstrations that illustrate how EAB technology solves real\-world challenges for higher education institutions.
* Participate as an embedded member of the Product organization by attending product planning sessions, roadmap reviews, design critiques, sprint reviews, and other product ceremonies.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineering teams to ensure prototypes and demonstrations accurately represent product functionality and design direction.
* Translate product requirements, concepts, and early\-stage ideas into compelling visual experiences that support discovery, planning, validation, and commercialization.
* Build and maintain reusable prototype assets utilizing EAB's design system, component libraries, and modern prototyping platforms.
* Explore and adopt emerging AI\-powered design and prototyping tools that improve the speed and quality of product visualization.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Partner Success, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to create product experiences that support launches, customer conversations, conferences, executive briefings, and strategic initiatives.
* Develop future\-state concepts that help leadership, customers, and internal teams visualize long\-term product strategy before engineering development begins.
* Continuously improve EAB's library of commercial product experiences, ensuring demonstrations remain aligned with evolving product capabilities and roadmap priorities.
* Participate in stretch projects and strategic initiatives that advance Product and Go\-to\-Market collaboration.

  


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Product Design, User Experience, Human\-Computer Interaction, Information Architecture, Graphic Design, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in UX design, product design, prototyping, product marketing, demonstration design, or related disciplines.
* Experience building interactive prototypes using Figma or comparable prototyping platforms.
* Strong visual design skills with exceptional attention to detail and an eye for polished user experiences.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, software platforms, and AI\-assisted design tools.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with experience working across cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* A portfolio demonstrating interactive prototypes, product experiences, UX work, or similar design projects.

  


**Ideal Qualifications:**


* Experience working with product management and agile software development teams.
* Familiarity with modern product design systems and component\-based design methodologies.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies to accelerate design and prototyping workflows.
* Experience creating executive presentations, customer demonstrations, product storytelling assets, or conference experiences.
* Familiarity with higher education technology or SaaS products.
* Understanding of design thinking, human\-centered design, and product development methodologies.
* Ability to balance creativity with technical accuracy when representing software products.
* Demonstrated curiosity, experimentation, and a passion for continuously improving design workflows and emerging technologies.
* Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB's mission, values, and aspirations.


*If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.*

  


**Compensation:**



The anticipated starting salary (base) range for this role is $67,500 \- $90,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.



This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

  


**Benefits:**



Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
* 20\+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
* Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
* Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre\-tax commuter plans
* Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
* Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
* Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
* Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non\-birthing parents
* Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
* Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
* Company\-provided life, AD\&D, and disability insurance
* Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
* Access to employee resource groups, merit\-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities

**About EAB**


At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data\-driven insights and best\-in\-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.



At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.



For more information, visit our careers page.

  


**The Role in Brief:**


***Product Experience Designer (PXD), Senior Analyst***
